title: English Muffins
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) warm water; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) sugar; 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) instant dry yeast; 1 1/4 cups (310 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) baking powder; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) salt; 3 round cookie cutters, about 3 1/2-inch (8.2-inch) in diameter and 2-inch (5-cm) high
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine warm water, sugar, yeast and 250 ml (1 cup) of flour with a whisk until smooth. Cover with a damp cloth and let rest in a warm and humid place for about 15 minutes.  In another bowl, combine remaining flour, baking powder and salt. Drizzle with yeast preparation and stir with a wooden spoon until mixture is smooth. Let stand for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until batter triples in volume.  Thoroughly butter the inside walls of three cookie cutters. Place in a large non-stick skillet. Place the pan over medium heat and warm up for about 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low and pour 125 ml (1/2 cup) of batter into each cutter. Cover with aluminum foil and cook for 10 minutes. Remove cutters and flip muffins. Cook uncovered for about 10 minutes. Cool completely on a wire rack. Repeat with remaining batter. Let cool. Slice in half and toast. Serve with butter and jam.

title: Homemade Granola
recipeIngredients: 3 cups (750 ml) rolled oats; 1 cup (250 ml) chopped plain almonds; 1/2 cup (125 ml) shelled plain pumpkin seeds; 1/2 cup (125 ml) shelled plain sunflower; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) salt; 1/2 cup (125 ml) maple syrup; 1/4 cup (60 ml) canola oil
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 160 °C (325 °F).  In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients. Add syrup and oil and toss to combine.  Spread mixture on a baking sheet. Bake for about 30 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Cool completely. If desired, add dried fruit, to taste (raisins, cranberries, blueberries, apricots, etc.). Store in an airtight container.

title: Slow Cooker Baked Beans with Maple Syrup
recipeIngredients: 4 1/2 cups (900 g) dry white beans or Navy beans; 6 cups (1.5 litres) cold water; 1 cup (250 ml) maple syrup; 1/2 cup (125 ml) ketchup; 1/2 lb (225 g) streaky salted pork, rind removed and chopped into lardons; 2 onions, coarsely chopped; 1 tbsp (15 ml) Dijon mustard; 1 tsp (5 ml) salt; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) ground pepper
recipeInstructions: Place beans in a large bowl. Cover with water and soak for 12 hours or overnight at room temperature. Add water, as needed, so that beans are always covered. Rinse and drain. In a slow cooker, combine all ingredients. Cover and cook for 8 to 9 hours on Low, or for 6 hours on High. Mix well. Adjust the seasoning.

title: American-Style Pancakes
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 tsp baking powder; 1/4 cup (55 g) sugar; 2 eggs; 2 cups (500 ml) milk; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract; Butter, for cooking
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the flour and baking powder. Add the remaining ingredients and whisk until the mixture is smooth. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. When the pan is hot, brush with butter. For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup (60 ml) of batter into the pan. Using the back of a spoon, spread out the batter to get a pancake about 6 inches (15 cm) in diameter.  Cook the pancake for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Flip with a large spatula when bubbles appear in the centre of the pancake or the edges appear cooked. Lower the heat, as needed, to give the batter time to cook through without over-browning.  Keep the pancakes warm on a baking sheet in an oven preheated to 200°F (95°) while you  cook the remaining pancakes, or serve them up as they’re cooked.  Drizzle with maple syrup, if desired.

title: Almond Turnovers
recipeIngredients: 7 oz		(200 g) almond paste (marzipan), chopped; 1/4 cup	(55 g) sugar; 1/4 cup	(55 g) unsalted butter, softened; 2 egg yolks; 2		drops almond extract (optional); 1/2 cup	(80 g) blanched almonds, toasted and roughly chopped; 2		packages (200 g each) store-bought puff pastry, thawed; 1		egg, lightly beaten; 1/4 cup 	(30 g) sliced almonds; 2 tbsp 		icing sugar
recipeInstructions: In a food processor, process the marzipan and sugar into fine pieces. Add the butter, egg yolks and almond extract. Pulse until smooth. Transfer to a bowl and add the almonds. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.  On a floured work surface, roll out the puff pastry into two 10-inch (25 cm) squares, about 1/8-inch (3 mm) thick. Cut each piece of dough into four squares.  Brush one side of the pastry with beaten egg. Spoon about 2 tbsp of almond filling in the centre of each square. Close to form triangles. With a fork, press edges to seal the dough.  Spread the turnovers out on the baking sheet. Using scissors, make a small incision in the centre of each turnover to allow steam to escape. Brush with remaining beaten egg and sprinkle with almonds. Bake for 25 minutes or until turnovers are a nice golden colour. Let cool completely and dust with icing sugar.

title: Chorizo Breakfast Burrito
recipeIngredients: 4 small flour tortillas; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) butter, softened; 1 cup (250 ml) grated cheddar cheese; 8 eggs, lightly beaten; 1/4 cup (60 ml) milk; 6 green onions, thinly sliced  ; 4 oz (117 g) chorizo sausage, diced; 1 jalapeño pepper, seeded and finely chopped; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) olive oil; 1 tomato, seeded and diced; Salsa, homemade or store-bought (optional); Sour cream (optional); Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 150 °C (300 °F).  Spread butter on both sides of the tortillas. In a large non-stick skillet, brown tortillas, one at a time, on each side. Place on a baking sheet and sprinkle with cheddar cheese. Place in the oven to melt the cheese while you prepare filling.  In a bowl, combine eggs with milk. Season with salt and pepper.  In the same skillet, brown sausage with onions and pepper in oil over medium heat. Add egg mixture and cook gently, stirring until desired doneness. Season with salt and pepper.  Spoon egg filling into tortillas. Top with tomatoes and roll tightly. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Fruit Bruschetta
recipeIngredients: 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) mango, peeled and diced (about 1 mango); 3/4 cup (180 ml) fresh raspberries; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) sugar; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) chopped fresh basil (or mint, lemon balm); 16 thin slices baguette, cut on the bias and toasted  ; 1 cup (250 ml) cottage cheese, drained in a sieve; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) maple syrup, or to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine fruit, sugar and basil. Let stand for 15 minutes and stir again.  Cover toasted bread with cottage cheese and top with fruit mixture. Drizzle with maple syrup. Serve immediately.

title: Clean-out-the-Fridge Strata
recipeIngredients: 1 onion, chopped; 1/2 lb (227 g) sliced ham, thinly sliced; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) olive oil; 8 eggs, lightly beaten  ; 2 1/4 cups (560 ml) milk; 1/2 cup (125 ml) 15% cream; 8 cups (2 litres) stale bread, cut into cubes (baguette loaf, cheese and bacon bread, etc.); 4 cups (1 litre) baby spinach (watercress or arugula); 3 cups (750 ml) cooked or grilled vegetables (asparagus, peppers, peas, broccoli, cauliflower, etc.); 2 cups (500 ml) grated Gruyère cheese (cheddar or raclette); Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions: In a large skillet, brown the onion and ham in the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Let cool.  In a large bowl, combine the eggs, milk, and cream. Season with salt and pepper. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Spoon into a 33 x 23-cm (13 x 9-inch) baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 to 8 hours. Pressed for time, let the bread soak for only 1 hour.  With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).  Remove the plastic wrap and bake for about 1 hour or until the centre of the strata is cooked. Allow to cool for 10 minutes and serve with a green salad.

title: Mushroom Crepes
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 3/4 cup (180 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) olive oil; 2 eggs; Salt and pepper  ; Softened butter, for cooking; 2 slices bacon, about 1/4-inch (1/2-cm) thick, cut into small pieces; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) butter; 2 cups (500 ml) baby potatoes, thinly sliced on a mandolin; 1 lb (454 g) mixed mushrooms of your choice, sliced; 1 large onion, chopped  ; 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped  ; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) chicken broth; 1/2 cup (125 ml) cultured cream; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) grated Emmental cheese (or whatever leftover cheese you have)
recipeInstructions: In a blender, combine all the ingredients until the batter is smooth. Season with salt and pepper.  In a 20-cm (8-inch) non-stick skillet, lightly brushed with butter, cook eight crêpes, one by one, with about 60 ml (1/4 cup) of the batter, browning them on both sides. Place the cooked crepes on a plate, as you go, and cover with aluminum foil to prevent them from drying out. Set aside.   In a large non-stick skillet, brown the bacon in the butter. Add the potatoes, mushrooms, and onion and sauté for about 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Season with salt and pepper. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle with the flour and stir to combine. Add the broth and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Simmer gently for about 5 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Adjust the seasoning.  With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Oil a 30 x 20-cm (11 x 8-inch) baking dish.  On a work surface, spoon about 125 ml (1/2 cup) of filling on each crepe. Roll and place them, side by side, in the prepared baking dish. Spread the sour cream on the crêpes and sprinkle with the cheese.  Bake for about 20 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown. If necessary, finish browning under the broiler. Serve with a green salad.

title: Caramelized Banana French Toast with Chocolate Sauce
recipeIngredients: 1/2 cup (125 ml) 35% cream, hot; 4 oz (115 g) dark chocolate, coarsely chopped; 4 bananas; 1/2 cup (125 ml) sugar; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) water; 3 eggs, lightly beaten; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) milk; 1/4 cup (60 ml) sugar; 8 slices white bread; 1/4 cup (60 ml) butter
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, pour hot cream over chocolate. With a whisk, stir until smooth. Set aside.   Cut each banana into two sections and then in half lengthwise.  In a non-stick skillet, melt sugar and water and cook until golden brown. Add bananas and coat with caramel. Remove from heat. Set aside.   In a large bowl, combine eggs, milk and sugar with a whisk. Set aside.  Spread banana mixture on four slices of bread and cover with remaining bread slices. Dip each sandwich, one at a time, into egg mixture, letting them soak thoroughly.  In a large non-stick skillet, brown sandwiches on both sides in butter. Cut each sandwich in half diagonally. Drizzle with chocolate sauce.

title: Oatmeal Pancakes with Apple and Blueberry Sauce
recipeIngredients: 4 Cortland apples, peeled, cored and sliced; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) lemon juice; 2 cups (500 ml) frozen blueberries; 1 cup (250 ml) sugar; 1 cup (250 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) quick-cooking rolled oats; 1/4 cup (60 ml) sugar; 2 teaspoons (10 ml) baking powder; A pinch of salt; 2 cups (500 ml) milk (see note); Butter, for cooking  ; Whipped cream, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, combine apples with lemon juice, blueberries and sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently. Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until mixture is slightly syrupy. Let cool.   In a bowl, combine flour, rolled oats, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in milk with a whisk until smooth. In a non-stick skillet lightly brushed with butter, cook pancakes over medium heat, one at a time, with about 60 ml (1/4 cup) of batter each, spooning into 12-cm (5-inch) discs. Cook for about a minute and a half on each side. As you go, place cooked pancakes on a plate in a warm oven and cover with aluminum foil to prevent them from drying out. Keep warm on a baking sheet. Stack three pancakes per person on a plate, top with blueberry sauce and whipped cream.

title: Fresh Goat Cheese Omelet
recipeIngredients: 3 eggs, lightly beaten  ; 1 1/2 teaspoons (7.5 ml) fresh chives, chopped; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) butter; 1 oz (28 g) fresh goat cheese or sharp cheddar cheese; Forget-me-not, violet or primrose flowers, for garnish  ; Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the eggs with the chives. Season with salt and pepper.  In a very hot 8-inch (20-cm) non-stick skillet, melt the butter. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. Cook over medium heat, breaking the bottom of the omelet with a spatula to facilitate cooking. When the edge of the omelet, not the centre, is almost cooked, crumble the cheese on one half of the omelet. With a spatula, fold the other side over the filling and slide onto a plate. Garnish with the flowers of your choice. Serve with toasted bread and a green salad.

title: Egg with Mushroom Cups
recipeIngredients: 3 slices bacon, cut into small pieces; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) olive oil; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) butter; 8 oz (227 g) white button mushrooms, thinly sliced; 2 shallots, finely chopped  ; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) all-purpose flour; 1/2 cup (125 ml) chicken broth; 2 teaspoons (10 ml) lemon juice; 6 eggs  ; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) chopped fresh chives; Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).  In a skillet, brown the bacon in the oil. Add the butter, mushrooms, and shallots and sauté until golden brown. Sprinkle with the flour and stir to combine. Add the broth, lemon juice and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Adjust the seasoning. Set aside.  Butter six 125 ml (1/2 cup) ramekins or Mason jars, and spread the filling at the bottom. Break an egg into each ramekin. Season with salt and pepper.  Prepare a water bath: place a cloth or cooking mat (Silpat) at the bottom of a large baking dish. Add the ramekins and pour hot water halfway up the ramekins. Bake for about 20 minutes or until the desired doneness of the eggs. Sprinkle with chives and serve.

title: Pear and Raspberry Jam
recipeIngredients: 1 1/4 lb (575 g) fresh or frozen raspberries (about 5 cups); 1 1/4 lb (575 g) ripe pears, cored and diced (about 4); 1/4 cup (60 ml) water; 4 cups (1 litre) sugar; 1 1/4 lb (575 g) firm pears, cored and diced (about 4); Juice of 1 lemon
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, combine the raspberries, ripe pears and water. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.  Add the sugar and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add the firm pears and lemon juice. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat for about 30 minutes or until the jam takes a syrupy texture.  Pour the jam into jars.

title: Ricotta-Stuffed Crepes with Orange Sauce
recipeIngredients: 1 egg; 2 tbsp sugar; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract; 1 cup (150 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) milk; Butter, for cooking; 1 container (475 g) ricotta cheese; 1/4 cup (55 g) sugar; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract; 1 orange, zest finely grated; 1/2 cup (125 ml) whipped cream (optional); 3 navel oranges, peels and pith removed and cut into segments (see note); 2 tbsp cornstarch; 1 cup (250 ml) orange juice; 2 tbsp sugar; 6 tbsp (90 ml) Grand Marnier or other orange liqueur
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, beat the egg with the sugar and vanilla. Add the flour alternating with the milk, whisking until smooth. Preheat a 7-inch (18 cm) non-stick skillet over medium heat. When the skillet is hot, brush with butter. For each crepe, pour about ¼ cup (60 ml) into the centre of the skillet and tilt to spread evenly over the entire bottom of the skillet. When the edge of the crepe easily peels off and begins to brown, after about 1 minute, flip the crepe with a spatula. Continue cooking for 30 seconds and remove the crepe from the skillet. Set aside on a plate. Cover with foil so the crepes don’t dry out. In a bowl, combine the ricotta, sugar, vanilla and orange zest. Fold in the whipped cream. Spread the ricotta filling over the crepes and roll each crepe up or fold in 4. Set aside. In a bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in the orange juice. In a saucepan, melt the sugar until it turns a light golden brown. Deglaze with the orange liqueur; the caramel will harden. Add the orange juice mixture and cook gently, while whisking, until the sauce thickens. Add the orange segments and stir gently to heat through. Top the warm or cold crepes with the hot sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Crispy French Toast with Custard Sauce
recipeIngredients: 6 egg yolks; 1/2 cup (105 g) sugar; 2 1/2 cups (625 ml) milk, hot; 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and seeds scraped, or 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract; 3 1/2 cups (330 g) muesli, without raisins; 3 eggs; 2 cups (500 ml) milk; 1/2 cup (125 ml) maple syrup; Butter, for browing; 8 slices crusty bread; Fresh fruit, for serving
recipeInstructions: On the top part of a double boiler, off the heat, beat the egg yolks and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the milk, vanilla seeds and the vanilla bean. Over a pan of simmering water (the water should not touch the top pan), cook the mixture for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until it coats the back of the spoon. Remove from the double boiler and let cool. Remove and compost the vanilla bean. Cover with plastic wrap directly on the surface of the custard. Let cool, then refrigerate until completely chilled. In a food processor, grind the muesli (or place in a sealable bag and crush with a rolling pin). Transfer to a shallow bowl. Set aside. In a bowl, beat the eggs, milk, and maple syrup. Dip the bread slices, one at a time, in the egg mixture until well coated, then coat with granola. In a skillet over medium heat, brown the bread on both sides in butter, a few slices at a time. Transfer to plates. Drizzle with the custard sauce or maple syrup. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Waffles with Cinnamon Applesauce
recipeIngredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch; 1 cup (250 ml) apple juice; 3 tbsp butter; 3 McIntosh apples, peeled, cored and sliced; 3 Cortland apples, peeled, cored and sliced; 1/4 cup (55 g) sugar; 1 tsp ground cinnamon; 2 cups (240 g) pastry flour; 2 tsp baking powder; 1/4 cup (55 g) sugar; 1 1/4 cups (310 ml) milk; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract; 3 eggs, separated; 1/4 cup (55 g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled
recipeInstructions: In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in the apple juice. In a pot over high heat, melt the butter. Add the apples and cook for 2 minutes. Add the sugar and cinnamon. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Add the cornstarch and apple juice mixture and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder and sugar. Set aside. In another bowl, combine the milk, vanilla and egg yolks. Set aside. In a third bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Using a wooden spoon, add the milk mixture to the dry ingredients and stir to combine. Using a whisk or spatula, gently fold in the egg whites, and then the butter. Preheat a waffle iron. Pour about ½ cup (125 ml) batter, or as recommended by the manufacturer, onto the waffle iron, close, and cook for 5 minutes or until the waffles are golden brown. Keep warm. Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve the waffles with cinnamon applesauce.

title: Dippy Eggs and Soldiers, Revisited
recipeIngredients: 8 slices bacon, finely chopped; 1/2 cup (50 g) strong cheddar cheese, grated; 2 tsp fresh chives, finely chopped; 4 slices white country bread, crust removed; 4 eggs
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the highest position, preheat the oven’s broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook the bacon until crisp. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels. Meanwhile, toast the bread. Place the toasts on the baking sheet. In a bowl, combine the bacon, cheese and chives. Season with pepper. Spread the bacon mixture on the toasts. Set aside. Gently place the eggs into a pot of boiling water. Boil the eggs for 4 minutes for soft-boiled eggs (the white will be firm and the yolk will be runny). Meanwhile, brown the cheese and bacon–topped toast under the broiler until the cheese has melted. On a work surface, cut each slice of toast into 4 strips, making sure they are the right width for dipping into the eggs. Place the eggs in eggcups and cut the top using a knife or an egg topper. Serve with the toasts for dipping into the egg yolk.

title: Pancakes and Blueberry Sauce
recipeIngredients: 3 cups (750 ml) fresh or frozen blueberries; 1/2 cup (125 ml) apple juice; 3/4 cup (180 ml) sugar; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) lemon juice; 1 cup (250 ml) all-purpose flour; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) baking powder; 3 eggs, separated; 1/2 cup (125 ml) buttermilk; 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) vanilla extract; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) unsalted butter
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, combine all the ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer on medium heat for  about 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Let cool at room temperature. In a bowl, combine the flour and baking powder. In another bowl, beat the egg yolks, butter milk, maple syrup and vanilla for 1 minute with an electric mixer. Add the dry ingredients and beat until the mixture is smooth.  In another bowl, beat the egg whites until soft peaks form. With a spatula, fold the egg whites into the batter. Heat a non-stick skillet on medium heat. Brush with butter. Pour 1/3 cup (75 ml) of batter for each pancake. Spread the batter into a 6–inch (15 cm) circle. Cook each side for 1 to 2 minutes or until they are nicely browned. Set aside in a warm oven. Serve 2 pancakes per person and serve with sauce.

title: Banana-Chocolate French Toast
recipeIngredients: 6 oz (170 g) dark chocolate (70% cacao), coarsely chopped; 1 cup (250 ml) 15% or 35% cream; 1/2 cup (125 ml) brown sugar; 2 cups (500 ml) milk; 4 eggs, lightly beaten; 1/2 cup (125 ml) brown sugar; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) ground cinnamon; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) vanilla extract; 4 to 6 slices (about 3 cm/1 1/4 in. thick) firm white sandwich bread (preferably day-old) or brioche; 1/4 cup (60 ml) salted butter; 4 to 6 bananas, sliced
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, heat all the ingredients over low heat, stirring frequently, until the chocolate melts. Set aside. In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, brown sugar, cinnamon and vanilla. Thoroughly soak the bread in the mixture, about 3 minutes per side.  In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, melt half the butter until it foams. Fry half the bread until golden, 4 to 5 minutes each side. Keep warm. Repeat with the remaining butter and bread. Top each piece of French toast with banana slices and drizzle with warm (not hot) chocolate sauce.

title: Scallop and Orange Salad in a Tulip
recipeIngredients: 3 tablespoons (45 ml) white wine vinegar; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) orange juice; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) olive oil; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) honey; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) Dijon mustard; Salt and pepper; 6 large scallops, patted dry (approximately 300 g); 2 tablespoons (30 ml) olive oil; 1 small English cucumber, peeled, seeded and thinly sliced into half rings  ; The skinless segments of 2 oranges; 4 tulips, with or without the stems and pistils; 1 tablespoons (15 ml) chopped fresh chives
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients with a whisk. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. In a non-stick skillet over high heat, brown the scallops in the oil for about 1 to 2 minutes per side, depending on their size. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate in the refrigerator until they are at room temperature. Slice thinly. In a bowl, combine the scallops, cucumber and oranges. Add the vinaigrette and toss to combine. Adjust the seasoning. Place each tulip on a plate or at the bottom of a glass, opening up the petals. Fill with the salad and sprinkle with the chives. Serve immediately.

title: Waffles
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1/4 cup (60 ml) cornstarch; 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) baking powder; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) baking soda; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) salt; 2 eggs; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) brown sugar; 1/4 cup (60 ml) canola oil; 1 cup (250 ml) buttermilk
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Set aside. In another bowl, whisk together the eggs and sugar for about 5 minutes or until they turn pale, form a ribbon, and triple in volume. Gradually whisk in the oil. With a spatula, add the dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk until the mixture is just moistened (there will be some lumps of flour). Let stand for 10 minutes. Preheat a waffle iron. Pour about 250 ml (1 cup) of batter at a time (for two waffles) and close the device (or as recommended by the manufacturer). Bake for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Keep warm. Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve with strawberry sauce as a dip.

title: Little Deviled Chickie Eggs
recipeIngredients: 12 eggs; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) mayonnaise, approximately; Carrot; Fresh rosemary; Sprouts or mixed lettuce leaves, for garnish; Salt and white pepper; Toothpick, as needed
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, place the eggs and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat. When the water begins to boil, cover the pan and remove from the heat. Let stand, off the heat, for 12 minutes. Remove the eggs from the hot water and immerse in ice-cold water to stop the cooking. Peel the eggs. With a small knife, halve each egg white, in a zigzag fashion, to mimic a broken shell and remove the yolks. In a bowl, combine the egg yolks and mayonnaise until the mixture is smooth. Season with salt and pepper. With your hands, shape 12 large balls, with about 15 ml (1 tablespoon) of egg yolk mixture, then 12 small balls with about 5 ml (1 teaspoon) of the remaining mixture. Insert the large balls in 12 half-egg whites and top with the 12 small securing them with a toothpick. If necessary, cut the bottom of the egg whites, so they are stable. Cut 12 small triangles in a thin slice of carrot as beaks. Cut the rounded end of 24 rosemary leaves eyes and decorate. Cover a serving platter with the sprouts and the chicks in their shells. Garnish with empty shells.

title: Yellow Tomato Quiche
recipeIngredients: 1 herb pie crust; 4 slices bacon, cut into pieces  ; 3/4 cup (180 ml) sour cream; 3/4 cup (180 ml) grated mozzarella cheese; 4 eggs, lightly beaten  ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) 15% cream or milk; 2 red or yellow tomatoes, seeded, cut into strips and patted dry  ; Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the lowest position, preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).  On a floured work surface, roll out the dough. Line a 23-cm (9-inch) pie plate with a removable bottom or regular. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.  In a small skillet, brown the bacon. Drain on paper towel. Set aside.  In a bowl, combine the sour cream, cheese, eggs, and cream. Season with salt and pepper.  Spread the bacon and tomatoes at the bottom of the crust. Pour the egg mixture over the tomatoes.  Bake for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve hot, warm or cold.

title: Kumquat Crêpe Suzette
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 3/4 cup (180 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 eggs; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) sugar; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) unsalted butter, melted; 1 pinch salt; 1/4 cup (60 ml) butter; 1 cup (250 ml) candied kumquats in their syrup; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) Grand Marnier
recipeInstructions: In a food processor or blender, combine all the ingredients until smooth. Heat a crêpe pan or a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Brush with butter. Pour 45 ml (3 tablespoons) of batter for each crêpe. Cook for about 1 minute per side or until golden brown. Set aside on a plate and cover. In a large skillet, melt the butter and add the candied kumquats. Bring to a boil. Add one pancake at a time in the syrup and fold into triangles. Set aside on a warm serving dish and cover. Continue with the remaining crêpes. In the same skillet, add the Grand Marnier to the remaining syrup and flambé. Pour over the crêpes.

title: Flaxseed Crêpes
recipeIngredients: 3 tablespoons (45 ml) flax seeds; 3 eggs; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 3/4 cup (180 ml) water; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) melted butter; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) sugar; A pinch of salt; 1 cup (250 ml) flour
recipeInstructions: In a coffee or flaxseed grinder, grind the flax seeds. In a bowl, whisk together all of the ingredients, except for the flaxseed, until the mixture is smooth. Pass the batter through a sieve. Stir in the ground flaxseed. Let rest for 15 minutes. Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Brush with butter. Pour about 75 ml (1/3 cup) of batter for each pancake. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side or until golden brown. Keep warm.

title: White Ale Waffles
recipeIngredients: 1 		bottle (341 ml) white ale; 1/2 cup 	(125 ml) water; 1 tsp		instant yeast; 1/4 cup 	(55 g) sugar; 2 cups 		(300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1/2 tsp 	baking powder; 1 tsp 		salt; 1 egg; 1 tsp 		(5 ml) vanilla extract; 1/3 cup 	(75 g) unsalted butter, melted
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the beer, water, yeast, and sugar. Let stand for 5 minutes. In another bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.  Add the egg and vanilla to the beer mixture. Add the dry ingredients and whisk for 2 minutes. Add the butter and whisk until the batter is smooth. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let rest for 1 hour in a warm, draft-free place. Preheat the waffle iron. Pour about 1/3 cup (75 ml) of batter per cavity. title: Savoury Bread Pudding
recipeIngredients: 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) 35% or 15% cream; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) milk; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) grated mozzarella; 5 eggs, lightly beaten; 1 large round loaf country-style bread (not sourdough), cut into 1 1/2-inch (4-cm) cubes (about 3 litres/12 cups); 4 slices bacon, cut crosswise into small pieces; 3/4 lb (340 g) cooked ham, diced; 6 green onions, chopped; 2 tomatoes, seeded and diced; Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions:
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Generously butter a tube cake pan with a removable bottom (preferably non-stick). 
Place the pan on a baking sheet in case of a leak.
 In a bowl, combine the cream, milk, cheese and eggs. Season with salt and pepper. Add the bread and let soak for about 15 minutes, gently stirring it a few times.  Meanwhile, in a skillet over medium-high heat, fry the bacon until barely ­crisp. Add the ham and brown. Add the green onions and sauté for 1 minute.  Add the tomatoes to the bread mixture and stir to combine. Adjust the seasoning. Pour into the cake pan and bake until golden, about 70 minutes. Let rest for 15 minutes. Run a thin-bladed knife between the edge of the pan and the pudding. Unmould. Run the knife under the pudding. Using two large spatulas, gently lift the pudding to detach it completely from the pan. Place on a serving platter. (This is best done with two people.)

title: Irish Oatmeal with Pears and Maple
recipeIngredients: 1 1/4 cups (310 ml) steel-cut oats; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) butter; 5 cups (1.25	litre) water; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) salt; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) butter; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) sugar; 2 pears, peeled, cored and diced; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) currants; 1/2 cup (125 ml) shelled pecans, toasted and coarsely chopped; Maple syrup
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan over medium-high heat, toast the oats in the butter for 2 minutes. Add the water and salt. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer gently, uncovered, until the oatmeal thickens and is tender, 25 to 30 minutes, stirring frequently, especially toward the end. Meanwhile, in a skillet over medium-high heat, cook the butter and sugar until they begin to colour. Add the pears and currants. Sauté until the pears are tender and coloured a light gold, about 4 minutes. Serve the hot oatmeal in bowls. Spoon some of the topping onto each portion. Sprinkle with pecans and drizzle with maple syrup.

title: Couscous with Apple Juice and Dates
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) fresh apple juice; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) maple syrup; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) ground cinnamon; 1 cup (250 ml) couscous; 1/2 cup (125 ml) Medjool dates, pitted and quartered; 1/2 cup (125 ml) toasted slivered almonds
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, bring the apple juice, maple syrup and cinnamon to a boil. Remove from the heat. Stir in the couscous and dates. Cover and let rest for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Add the almonds. Serve hot or warm for breakfast.

title: Asparagus and Ricotta Filled Crepes
recipeIngredients: 1 egg; 1/4 cup (60 ml) flour; 1/2 cup (125 ml) milk; Salt and pepper; 3/4 cup (180 ml) ricotta cheese; 1/3 cup (75 ml) fresh Parmesan cheese, grated; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) 35% cream; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) fresh parsley, chopped; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) fresh chives, chopped; Salt and pepper; 24 asparagus, grilled or steamed; 1 recipe Hollandaise Sauce (see recipe for Grilled Asparagus with Tarragon Sauce); Fresh herbs for garnish
recipeInstructions: Preheat the oven to 160 °C (325 °F). In a bowl, combine the ricotta, Parmesan, cream and herbs. Season with salt and pepper. In a bowl, whisk together all the batter ingredients. Cook four 20-cm (8-inch) crêpes in a non-stick skillet. Set aside. Divide the filling among the crêpes. Spread the asparagus over the filling. Close the crêpes, giving them the shape of a cone. Place the crêpes on a baking sheet. Cover with aluminum foil and reheat in the oven. Right out of the oven, place the crêpes on serving plates. Drizzle with hollandaise sauce and garnish with fresh herbs.

title: Low-fat Cretons
recipeIngredients: 1 lb (454 g) lean ground pork; 1/2 cup (125 ml) white wine; 1/2 cup (125 ml) water; 1 onion, finely chopped; 8 soda crackers, finely crushed; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) Dijon mustard; 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) ground coriander; 1/4 teaspoon (1 ml) dried oregano; 1 pinch ground cloves; 1 pinch ground cinnamon; Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until the meat is cooked. Season with salt and pepper. title: Gravlax Omelet with Maltese Sauce
recipeIngredients: 12 	eggs, lightly beaten; 2 tablespoons (30 	ml) chopped flat-leaf parsley; 2 tablespoons (30 	ml) chopped fresh tarragon; 1/4 cup (60 	ml) butter; 1 1/2 cups (375 	ml) diced gravlax or smoked salmon; Salt and pepper; Fresh chives, chopped; 1 recipe Maltese sauce
recipeInstructions:
Preheat the oven to 100°C (200°F). In a bowl, combine the eggs and herbs. Season with salt and pepper. Preheat 2 23-cm (9-inch) non-stick frying pans over medium heat. In each pan, melt 15 ml (1 tablespoon) butter until it foams, then pour in a quarter of the egg mixture. Fry over medium heat, using a spatula to pull apart the bottom of each omelet and expedite the 
cooking. Season with salt and pepper. When the edges (not the centres) of the omelets are almost done, sprinkle one side of each omelet with 1/4 of the diced salmon. Using the spatula, fold the omelet over the filling and slide onto a plate. Keep warm in the oven. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
 Nap with Maltese sauce and garnish with chives.

title: Berry Jelly
recipeIngredients: 1 to 1 1/2 tsp gelatin (see note); 1 cup (250 ml) cranberry juice; 2 tbsp sugar; 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) fresh berries of your choice (blackberries, blueberries, raspberries); 1 cup (250 ml) 10% plain yogurt; 2 tbsp (30 ml) honey; 1/2 cup (65 g) homemade or store-bought granola
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup (60 ml) of the juice. Let bloom for 5 minutes. In a pot, heat the remaining juice and sugar until it dissolves. Remove from the heat. Add the gelatin and stir until melted. Let cool. Divide the fruit into 4 dessert cups. Pour in the juice. Refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. In a bowl, combine the yogurt and honey. Spoon the yogurt over the fruit jelly and garnish with granola.

title: Ham and Egg Cups with an Arugula Salad
recipeIngredients: 8 thin slices Black Forest ham, about 6-inch (15-cm) in diameter; 8 eggs; Salt and pepper; 4 cups (1 litre) baby arugula; 1 red bell pepper, grilled and cut into thin strips; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) red wine vinegar; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) olive oil; Salt and pepper

title: Blueberry Pancakes
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 tsp baking powder; 1/4 cup (55 g) sugar; 2 eggs; 2 cups (500 ml) milk; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract; 1 1/4 cups (190 g) fresh blueberries, or frozen blueberries, thawed; Butter, for cooking
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the flour and baking powder. Add the sugar, eggs, milk and vanilla. Whisk until smooth. If the blueberries are fresh, fold them into the batter. If they are frozen and thawed, add them to the pan when you cook the pancakes. In a non-stick skillet over medium heat, melt a little butter. Pour ¼ cup (60 ml) of batter and spread it, tilting the skillet to obtain a 6-inch (15 cm) pancake. If using frozen and thawed blueberries, scatter 1 tbsp of blueberries over each pancake. Cook for 2 minutes on each side. Stack them in a warm oven as you go. Serve the pancakes with maple syrup, if desired.

title: Eggs in Red Wine Sauce (Meurette)
recipeIngredients: 6 bacon slices, chopped; 1 onion, finely chopped; 1 garlic clove, finely chopped; 1 carrot, diced small; 1 celery stalk, diced small; 1 bay leaf; 1 sprig thyme; 1 cup (250 ml) red wine; 1 cup (250 ml) chicken broth; 20 pearl onions, blanched for 2 minutes, then peeled; 1/2 lb (225g) small white button mushrooms, quartered; 1/3 (75 g) butter, softened; 30 ml (2 tablespoons) butter, softened; 2 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 tbsp (15 ml) white vinegar; 4 eggs; 4 slices toasted bread, crusts removed; Fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped, for garnish
recipeInstructions: In a pot over medium-high heat, brown the bacon. Add the onion, garlic, carrot and celery. Cook until the vegetables are starting to brown. Add the bay leaf, thyme, wine and broth. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. In a skillet over medium heat, sauté the pearl onions and mushrooms in 3 tbsp of the butter for 5 minutes or until the moisture in the mushrooms has evaporated. Add the mushrooms and pearl onions to the mixture simmering in the pot.  In a bowl, thoroughly blend the remaining butter and flour. Whisk into the pot. Stir constantly until the sauce thickens, about 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Keep warm. Remove the thyme sprig and bay leaf and compost them. In a pot of simmering salted water, add the vinegar. Break the eggs, one at a time, into a sauce and slide them into the water. Poach 2 eggs at a time for about 3 minutes or until the desired doneness. Drain the poached eggs on a paper towel-lined plate. Place the toast on plates and drizzle with the sauce. Place a poached egg in the centre of each plate. Garnish with chopped parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Brittany-Style Pancakes
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 tbsp to ⅓ cup (30 to 70 g)sugar; 3 eggs; 2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract; 2 1/2 cups (625 ml) milk; Butter, for cooking
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, eggs, vanilla and 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) milk until the batter is smooth. Gradually whisk in the remaining milk.  Heat an 8-inch (20 cm) non-stick skillet over medium heat. When the skillet is hot, brush it with butter. For each crepe, pour about 1/4 cup (60 ml) of batter into the centre of the skillet. Distribute the batter by tilting the skillet so that it evenly coats the bottom of the skillet.  When the edges lift away from the skillet and start to brown, flip the crepe over with a spatula. Continue cooking for 30 seconds or until lightly golden. Transfer the crepe to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.

title: Croissants French Toast with Blueberry Sauce
recipeIngredients: 3 cups (750 ml) blueberries, fresh or frozen; 1/4 cup (60 ml) water; 1/2 cup (125 ml) sugar; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) fresh ginger, grated (optional); 3 eggs, lightly beaten; 1/4 cup (60 ml) milk; 1/4 cup (60 ml) maple syrup; A pinch of salt; 4 stale croissants; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) butter
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan, combine 500 ml (2 cups) of blueberries, the water, sugar and ginger. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes. Pour into a blender and purée until smooth. Add the remaining blueberries and let cool. In a bowl, combine the eggs, milk, maple syrup and salt. Cut the croissants in half lengthwise. Dip each piece in the egg mixture, turning to coat both sides. In a skillet, melt half the butter over medium heat and brown half of the croissants for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Keep warm. Repeat with the remaining butter and croissants. Place the croissants bottom in the four plates. Spoon the sauce over and cover the croissant tops.

title: Aged Cheddar and Apple Omelet with Crisp Spicy Bacon
recipeIngredients: 6 slices bacon; 1 teaspoon (5 ml) Dijon mustard; 2 teaspoons (10 ml) maple syrup; 1 pinch Cayenne pepper; Pepper; 2 Cortland apples, peeled, cored and quartered; 3 tablespoons (45 ml) butter; 6 eggs, lightly beaten; Salt and pepper; 2/3 cup (150 ml) aged cheddar, grated; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) walnuts; Chopped chives, for garnish
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the bacon slices on the sheet. In a small bowl, stir together the mustard, maple syrup and cayenne pepper. Lightly brush the bacon with the mustard mixture. Season with pepper. Bake for 20 minutes or until the bacon is crisp. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. Keep warm. In a skillet, brown the apples for 3 to 4 minutes in 15 ml (1 tablespoon) of butter. Set aside. Split the remaining butter between two 15 to 18-cm (6 to 7-inch) hot non-stick pans. Pour half the eggs into each pan. Cook over medium heat, breaking the bottom of the omelet with a spatula to facilitate cooking. Season with salt and pepper. When the edges of the omelet - and not the centre - are almost cooked, sprinkle with the cheese. Add the apples on one half of each omelet, then the nuts. With a spatula, fold the other side of each omelet over the filling and slide onto a plate. Garnish with chives and serve with crisp spicy bacon.

title: Buckwheat Crepe Cake with Sausage and Eggs
recipeIngredients: 1/2 cup (125 ml) buckwheat flour; 1/4 cup (60 ml) all-purpose flour; 1 pinch salt; 1 egg; 1 1/4 cups (310 ml) milk; 1 tablespoon (15 ml) melted butter; 300 g breakfast sausage, removed from their casing; 2 tablespoons (30 ml) butter; 2 cups (500 ml) medium-sharp cheddar, grated; 8 eggs; 2/3 cup (150 ml) milk; Salt and pepper
recipeInstructions:
In a bowl, whisk all the ingredients until smooth. In a well-buttered 23-cm (9-inch) non-stick skillet, cook the crepes on both sides; count about 60 ml (1/4 cup) of batter for each. Transfer to a plate. In a skillet, brown the sausage meat over medium heat in half the butter for 5 minutes. Set aside in a bowl and let cool. Add 125 ml (1/2 cup) of the cheese and combine. Simultaneously, in a bowl, combine the eggs with the milk. Season with salt and pepper. Cook this mixture into the remaining butter over low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Line the bottom of a 23-cm (9-inch) springform pan with parchment paper. Butter the sides. Place a crepe at the bottom of the pan, and add half the egg mixture. Cover with another crepe, then add half the sausage mixture. Repeat with the remaining ingredients, topping with the remaining cheese. Bake for 15 minutes or until the top is golden brown, finish browning under the broiler, if necessary. Let rest for 5 minutes, then unmould.

 Cut into wedges and serve.
description: Buckwheat Crepe Cake with Sausage and Eggs

title: Buckwheat Crepes with Ham, Asparagus and Cheese
recipeIngredients: 1 egg; 1/2 cup 	(75 g) buckwheat flour; 1/2 cup 	(75 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 1/2 cups 	(375 ml) milk; 1/4 tsp 	salt; 1 tbsp 		(15 ml) butter; 1 		small onion, finely chopped; 2 tbsp 		(30 ml) butter; 2 tbsp 		(30 ml) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 cup 		(250 ml) milk; 1 pinch 	ground nutmeg or ground clove; 8 		large, thin slices of Black Forest ham; 12 		asparagus spears, trimmed, cooked and kept warm; 1 cup 		(100 g) Gruyère or Emmental cheese, grated
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together all of the ingredients, except for the butter, until smooth. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a saucepan, sauté the onion in the butter for 2 minutes. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Slowly whisk in the milk. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes. Mix in the ground nutmeg or clove, to taste. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. In a 10.5-inch (26.5-cm) non-stick skillet or crepe pan, melt the butter. For each crepe, pour about 1/2 cup (125 ml) of batter into the skillet. Cook on both sides until golden brown. Stack the crepes on a plate.  Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Place one crepe on a work surface and cover with 2 slices of ham. Pour 1/4 cup (60 ml) of béchamel sauce over half of the crepe. Place 3 asparagus spears on top of the béchamel and sprinkle with ¼ cup (25 g) of cheese. Fold the crepe over the filling and place on the baking sheet. Assemble the remaining crepes in the same way.  Cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Tartiflette
recipeIngredients: 1 3/4 lb (800 g) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks or baby potatoes, halved; 6 oz (170 g) bacon, diced; 1 onion, diced; 1 clove garlic, finely chopped; 1/2 cup (125 ml) white wine; 1/4 cup (60 ml) 35% cooking cream (optional); 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg; 1 whole Reblochon cheese wheel (see note)
recipeInstructions: Place the potatoes in a pot. Cover with cold water. Season with salt. Bring to a boil and simmer until tender. Drain and let cool. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).  In a large oven-proof skillet (see note) over medium-high heat, lightly brown the bacon. Add the onion and garlic and cook, while stirring, until the onion is soft. Add the potatoes and deglaze with the wine. Lightly season with salt and pepper, keeping in mind that Reblochon is quite a salty cheese.  Drizzle the cream over the potatoes. Sprinkle with nutmeg.  With a knife, scrape some of the rind from the cheese. Cut the wheel in half horizontally. Place the two pieces of cheese side by side on the potatoes, cut-side down.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serve the tartiflette hot. Serve with a green salad, if desired.

title: Chicken and Bacon Caesar Bowls
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (500 ml) chicken broth or water; 1 cup (200 g) long-grain parboiled rice; 6 slices less salt bacon (see note); 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 lemon, zest finely grated; 1 garlic clove, finely grated; 1 lb (450 g) boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed; 3 cups (150 g) day-old bread, cubed; 1/2 cup (35 g) fresh Parmesan cheese, grated, plus more for serving ; 1/3 cup (75 ml) mayonnaise; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice; 1 tbsp (15 ml) Dijon mustard; 4 anchovy fillets, chopped (optional); 2 romaine lettuce hearts, leaves torn; 2 tbsp capers ; Lemon wedges, for serving
recipeInstructions:
In a pot, bring the broth to a boil. Season with salt. Add the rice and mix well. Reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let sit, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the grains of rice with a fork. Set aside. Meanwhile, with both racks in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).





 Spread the bacon slices out on a baking sheet lined with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Bake for 15 minutes or until cooked. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the oil, lemon zest and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
 On a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet, coat the chicken with 1 tbsp (15 ml) of the oil mixture. Spread the chicken out on the baking sheet. Bake for 18 minutes, at the same time as the bacon, or until the chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile, coat the bread cubes with the remaining oil mixture. Remove the baking sheet of bacon from the oven. Drain the bacon on a plate lined with paper towels. Let cool. Break the bacon into pieces.
 Place the bread on the baking sheet used to cook the bacon and toss to coat with the cooking fat. Bake the bread for 8 minutes or until the croutons are golden, stirring halfway through cooking. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the rice and lettuce among four shallow bowls. Top with the chicken, croutons, bacon and capers. Drizzle with the dressing. Sprinkle with Parmesan and season with pepper. Serve with lemon wedges.
description: We’re changing up classic Caesar salad for these meal-sized bowls with chicken and bacon. Bursting with rice, lettuce, reduced salt bacon, chicken, croutons, capers and creamy dressing, this recipe is hearty enough for supper any night of the week.

title: Air Fryer Buffalo-Style Fried Chicken Burgers
recipeIngredients: 1/4 cup (55 g) butter; 1/2 cup (125 ml) hot sauce (see note); 2 tbsp brown sugar ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar; 1/4 cup (30 g) blue cheese, crumbled, plus more for serving ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) mayonnaise; 1/4 cup (60 ml) sour cream; 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice; 1 tsp (5 ml) honey; 1 small garlic clove, finely chopped; 1/2 celery stalk, cut into small dice (optional); 1 small red onion, thinly sliced; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice; 1 tbsp (15 ml) water; 1 tbsp sugar; 1/2 cup (75 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 eggs ; 3 cups (90 g) crispy rice cereal, lightly crushed (see note); 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder ; 1 1/2 tsp onion powder ; 1 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes; 1 1/2 tsp dried tarragon ; 1/2 tsp salt ; 1 lb (450 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 4 to 5 thighs) ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) vegetable oil; 4 brioche hamburger buns, warmed (see note) ; Romaine lettuce leaves, torn, to taste
recipeInstructions:
In a small pot, combine all of the ingredients. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the sauce has reduced by half. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. The sauce will keep for 3 days in an airtight container in the refrigerator (see note). In a small glass bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook in the microwave oven for 1 minute. Let marinate at room temperature while you prepare the remaining ingredients. In a shallow dish, place the flour. In a second shallow dish, lightly beat the eggs. In a third dish, combine the crushed cereal with the spices and salt.  Working one piece at a time, dredge the chicken in the flour, shaking off any excess. Dip into the beaten eggs, letting some of the excess drip off. Press lightly into the cereal mixture to coat well. Place on a plate. Using a pastry brush, cover the chicken with the oil on both sides.
 Place the chicken in the basket of an air fryer, evenly spaced out. Cook for 15 minutes at 375°F (190°C). Flip the chicken over and continue to cook for 10 minutes or until cooked through and nicely browned. Spread the blue cheese sauce over the inside of the warmed hamburger buns. Top the bun bottoms with the chicken. Using a pastry brush, coat the chicken with the Buffalo sauce. Garnish with lettuce and marinated onions. Sprinkle with blue cheese. Close with the bun tops.
description: Here’s a deliciously indulgent fried chicken burger that you can cook in the air fryer. Coat the chicken in a crispy rice cereal breading before placing it in the air fryer’s basket and cooking it until it’s extra crunchy. When assembling the burgers, spread a tangy Buffalo sauce over the meat, followed by a blue cheese sauce and pickled onions.

title: Cacciatore Sauce
recipeIngredients: 1 carrot, cut into chunks; 1 celery stalk, cut into chunks; 1 onion, cut into 8 pieces; 3 garlic cloves, halved; 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes ; 1/2 lb (225 g) white mushrooms, halved; 1/4 lb (115 g) pancetta, diced; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1 1/2 lb (675 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) tomato paste; 3 1/2 cups (875 ml) chicken broth; 1 can (14 oz/398 ml) diced plum tomatoes
recipeInstructions: In a food processor, finely chop the carrot, celery, onion, garlic and red pepper flakes. Transfer to a bowl. Finely chop the mushrooms. Transfer to another bowl. Set aside. In a large pot over medium-high heat, brown the pancetta in the oil. Using a slotted spoon, remove the pancetta from the pot and set aside on a plate. In the same pot over high heat, brown the chicken in the pancetta cooking fat. Season with salt and pepper. Set the chicken aside with the pancetta. In the same pot over medium-high heat, soften the carrot mixture for 2 minutes while stirring. Add more oil as needed. Add the mushrooms and continue to cook for 5 minutes or until the liquid has evaporated. Season with salt and pepper. Add the tomato paste to the pot and continue to cook for 1 minute while stirring. Deglaze with 1 cup (250 ml) of the chicken broth. Let reduce by half. Add the tomatoes, remaining broth, chicken and pancetta. Bring to a boil. Simmer for 30 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Adjust the seasoning. Serve the cacciatore sauce over spaghetti. Garnish with grated fresh Parmesan cheese and finely chopped flat-leaf parsley, if desired.
description: For a good dose of comfort, a bowl of spaghetti is always welcome. To switch up from your usual Bolognese, try this cacciatore sauce with diced chicken thighs, pancetta and mushrooms. The tomato-based sauce, which is reduced along with chicken broth, becomes rich and delicious. Simply boil some pasta and warm the sauce before serving.

title: Chicken, Leek and Tarragon Pot Pie
recipeIngredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, softened ; 1/4 cup (40 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 4 tsp cornstarch ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) milk; 3 cups (285 g) leeks, thinly sliced; 2 tbsp unsalted butter ; 2 1/2 cups (625 ml) chicken broth; 1 cup (160 g) russet potatoes, peeled and diced	; 1 1/2 cups (255 g) cooked chicken, diced (about 1/2 store-bought roasted chicken) ; 3 tbsp tarragon leaves, finely chopped (see note) ; 2 cups (300 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1/2 tsp salt ; 1 cup (225 g) cold unsalted butter, thinly sliced  ; 2/3 cup (150 ml) ice water; 1 egg yolk       ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) milk
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the butter and flour. Set aside.  In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch and milk until smooth. Set aside.  In a pot over medium heat, soften the leeks in the butter. Season with salt and pepper. Add the broth and potato. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are al dente. Add the beurre manié to the pot while stirring gently. Bring to a boil while stirring. Add the milk mixture. Bring to a boil again. Add the chicken and tarragon. Mix well. Adjust the seasoning. Transfer to another bowl and refrigerate while you prepare the dough. In a bowl, combine the flour and salt. Using your fingertips, incorporate the butter into the flour until flaky. Gradually add the water and combine just until the dry ingredients are moistened, making sure to leave pieces of butter intact. The dough will be soft and sticky. On a floured work surface, roll the dough out to form a 13 x 8-inch (33 x 20 cm) rectangle. Using a pastry brush, remove any excess flour. Fold the dough in 3 widthwise. Fold the dough in half lengthwise to form a square. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until the dough is firm.  In a small bowl, combine the egg yolk and milk. Set aside. With the rack in the lowest position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).  On a floured work surface, cut the square of dough into two pieces. Roll each piece of dough out to form an 11-inch (28 cm) circle. Line a 9-inch (23 cm) pie plate with one circle of dough. Make incisions at the centre of the second circle of dough. Spread the chicken filling out in the bottom crust. Brush the edge of the crust with the egg wash. Cover with the top crust and remove any excess dough as needed. Seal the dough together by pressing on the edge of the pie with your fingers, then scallop the edge. Brush the pie with the egg wash. Freeze at this point, if desired (see note). Bake for 45 minutes or until the dough is nicely browned. Let rest for 15 minutes before serving. Serve with green salad, if desired.
description: Chicken, Leek and Tarragon Pot Pie This chicken pot pie freezes easily and is perfect for making ahead. The chicken filling includes leeks, russet potatoes and fresh tarragon, layered in a crust that can either be frozen for a future dinner or baked to enjoy the same day.

title: Grilled Citrus Chicken
recipeIngredients: 12 boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 2 lb/900g); 2 garlic cloves, chopped; 1 orange, juiced; 1 lime, juiced; 3 tbsp (45 ml) vegetable oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 1 1/2 tsp ground cumin ; 1 1/2 tsp chili powder ; 1/2 tsp salt ; Orange wedges, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients except for the orange wedges. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes or up to 8 hours. Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high (see note). Oil the grate. Drain the chicken and set the marinade aside. Reduce the temperature of the barbecue to medium-low. Place the chicken on the grate. Using a pastry brush, cover the chicken with the reserved marinade. Close the lid and grill for 8 to 10 minutes on each side or until the chicken is cooked through. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer the chicken to a serving dish. Serve with orange wedges and our watermelon, lime and jalapeño salad, if desired.
description: This grilled citrus chicken is easy to make and requires little prep time. Let the chicken marinate in a mixture of garlic, citrus juice, spices and honey, and then grill. Serve the meat with a salad for a tasty and refreshing weeknight meal.

title: Warm Roast Chicken and Vegetable Salad with Garlic Sauce
recipeIngredients: 1 butternut squash, about 2.2 lb (1 kg), peeled, halved lengthwise and seeded ; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup; 2 leeks, white parts only, cut into rounds 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick ; 1 lb (450 g) boneless, skinless chicken breasts ; 1 lb (450 g) Brussels sprouts, thinly sliced; 1/2 tsp salt ; 1/4 cup (40 g) dried cranberries, chopped; 3 tbsp (45 ml) apple cider vinegar; 2 tbsp (30 ml) whole-grain mustard; Garlic sauce, to taste (see note); 1/4 cup (40 g) roasted sunflower seeds
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).  On a work surface, cut the squash into halfmoons about 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick. Place the squash slices on a non-stick or foil-lined baking sheet. Toss with 3 tbsp (45 ml) of the oil and the maple syrup. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for 25 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Add the leeks and mix well. Push the vegetables away from the centre of the baking sheet. Place the chicken at the centre of the baking sheet and coat with the remaining oil. Season with salt and pepper. Bake the vegetables and chicken for 20 minutes. Finish cooking under the broiler for 4 to 5 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are caramelized. Meanwhile, in a bowl, massage the sprouts with the salt for 2 minutes. Add the cranberries, vinegar and mustard. Mix well. Let marinate for 20 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. On a plate, using two forks, shred the chicken. Return the shredded chicken to the baking sheet. Add the Brussels sprout salad and toss well with the roasted vegetables and chicken. Transfer the chicken and vegetable salad to a serving dish. Drizzle with the garlic sauce and garnish with the sunflower seeds.
description: Even in winter, meal salads are always welcome. Roasted vegetables provide comfort, paired with shredded Brussels sprout leaves for a pop of colour. Shredded chicken and a creamy garlic sauce are added to make it a nourishing dish.

title: Chicken, Potato and Pea Curry
recipeIngredients: 1 onion, chopped; 2 garlic cloves, chopped; 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil; 1 tbsp curry powder; 1 tsp garam masala; 3/4 cup (25 g) cilantro stems and leaves, separated and finely chopped, plus more for serving; 1 lb (450 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cubed (see note); 2 potatoes, peeled and diced; 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cubed; 1 can (14 oz/398 ml) diced plum tomatoes; 1 cup (250 ml) water; 1 cup (150 g) frozen peas, thawed; 1/2 cup (125 ml) 35% cream
recipeInstructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the onion and garlic in the oil. Add the spices and cilantro stems. Continue to cook for 1 minute while stirring. Add the chicken, potatoes and bell pepper. Continue to cook for 1 minute, stirring to coat everything well with the spice mixture. Add the tomatoes and water. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Remove the lid. Add the peas, cream and cilantro leaves. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Simmer for 2 minutes while stirring. Divide the chicken curry among four plates. Garnish with cilantro leaves. Serve with naan bread, if desired.
description: This creamy chicken curry is seasoned with a mix of garam masala, curry powder and fresh cilantro. We opted for chicken thighs, which remain tender even after simmering in the sauce. A comforting dish that will warm both body and soul.

title: Fried Chicken Fingers with Spiced Yogurt Sauce
recipeIngredients: 2 tsp sweet paprika; 1/2 tsp garlic powder; 1/2 tsp ground coriander seeds; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 2 tsp (10 ml) harissa; 1/4 cup (60 ml) water; 3/4 cup (180 ml) 11% plain yogurt; 3 eggs; 1/3 cup (75 ml) 11% plain yogurt (see note); 2 tsp (10 ml) harissa; 2/3 cup (100 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 cups (160 g) panko breadcrumbs; 1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick; Vegetable oil, for frying
recipeInstructions: In a small pot over medium heat, cook the spices in the oil for 1 minute while stirring with a wooden spoon. Add the harissa and continue to cook for 30 seconds while stirring. Pour in the water and bring to a boil. Simmer for 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl and let cool for 30 minutes. Add the yogurt. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Preheat the oil in a deep fryer to 350°F (180°C). Set a wire rack over a baking sheet. In a shallow dish, whisk together the eggs, yogurt and harissa. In a second shallow dish, place the flour. Season with salt and mix well. In a third shallow dish, place the breadcrumbs. Working one at a time, dip the strips of chicken in the egg mixture, letting some of the excess drip off. Coat with the flour, shaking off any excess. Dip into the egg mixture a second time. Press into the breadcrumbs to coat well. Place on another baking sheet. Freeze at this point, if desired (see note). Fry one-quarter of the chicken fingers at a time in the hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden and crispy. Drain on the wire rack. Season lightly with salt. Place the chicken fingers on a serving dish. Serve with the spiced yogurt sauce.
description: We’re integrating 11% yogurt into the coating for these breaded chicken fingers. Plump strips of chicken are first dipped into a mixture of yogurt, eggs and harissa, before getting coated with breadcrumbs. We’ve chosen a thick, high-fat yogurt so it can more thoroughly coat the chicken.The result is super crispy chicken fingers that we’re serving up with a spiced harissa yogurt.

title: Roast Chicken with Confit Tomatoes, Carrots and Beets
recipeIngredients: 1 grain-fed chicken, about 5 1/2 lb (2.5 kg); 1 tbsp salt ; 1 lemon, halved ; 1 1/2 lb (675 g) Nantes carrots, various colours, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) pieces on an angle ; 1 1/2 lb (675 g) yellow beets, peeled and cut into 8 wedges each ; 1 1/2 lb (675 g) red and yellow cherry tomatoes, halved ; 8 garlic cloves, peeled; 2 rosemary sprigs ; 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes ; 1/2 cup (115 g) butter ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) maple syrup ; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice; 2/3 cup (30 g) flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped; 1 small shallot, finely chopped; 1 garlic clove, finely chopped; 1 pinch red pepper flakes
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). On a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet, or in a roasting pan, place the chicken breast-side up. Sprinkle the salt over the chicken skin. Rub the outside and inside of the chicken with the cut-side of a lemon half for 1 minute, focusing primarily on the breasts. Attach the legs together with butcher’s twine and tuck the wings under the back of the chicken. Arrange the carrots, beets, tomatoes, garlic and rosemary sprigs around the chicken. Season with salt and the red pepper flakes. Squeeze the remaining lemon half over the vegetables. In a small glass bowl, melt the butter with the maple syrup in the microwave oven. Using a pastry brush, cover the surface of the chicken with some of the butter mixture. Pour the remaining butter mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat well. Bake for 2 hours or until the juice of the tomatoes has almost completely evaporated and a thermometer inserted in the thigh of the chicken, without touching bone, reads 180°F (82°C), stirring the vegetables a few times during cooking. Let rest for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt. Place the chicken on a large serving dish. Gently stir the vegetables in the cooking juices, then arrange them around the chicken. Serve with the green sauce, toasted country bread and fresh cheese, such as goat cheese, if desired.
description: Cooked on the show La cuisine d’Isabelle et Ricardo, this whole chicken served in the centre of the table will surely impress when entertaining. Coat the bird in butter and maple syrup, and surround it with beautiful vegetables such as carrots, beets and tomatoes. By roasting the vegetables in the chicken’s cooking juices, they stew and become almost confit. Serve the browned chicken with a green parsley, garlic and lemon sauce. All that’s left to do is to sit down at the table with your guests and enjoy!

title: Chicken Tikka with Yogurt
recipeIngredients: 2 tbsp fresh ginger, finely grated ; 4 garlic cloves, finely grated; 1 tbsp garam masala; 1 tbsp sweet paprika ; 1 tsp ground cumin ; ½ tsp turmeric ; ¼ tsp cayenne pepper ; 1 ½ tsp salt; 1 tsp (5 ml) vegetable oil ; ¾ cup (180 ml) 11% plain yogurt; 2 lb (900 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, each cut into 3 pieces ; 2 onions, thinly sliced; 3 tbsp butter ; 1 can (14 oz/398 ml) diced tomatoes; 1 cup (250 ml) water; 1 cup (250 ml) 11% plain yogurt; 6 cups (140 g) baby spinach; Cilantro leaves, for serving
recipeInstructions: In a small bowl, combine the ginger, garlic, spices and salt and oil. Season generously with pepper. In another bowl, combine the yogurt with half of the ginger mixture. Add the chicken and toss to coat well with the marinade. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for 4 to 8 hours. Cover the remaining ginger mixture and refrigerate it, reserving it for the sauce. In a large, deep skillet over medium heat, cook the onions in the butter for 7 minutes or until starting to brown. Add the remaining ginger mixture. Continue to cook for 1 minute, stirring to coat the onions well. Add the tomatoes and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, with the rack in the upper third, preheat the oven to broil. Line a baking sheet with foil. Spread the chicken out on the baking sheet. Broil the chicken for 6 to 12 minutes or until nicely browned. Flip the chicken over and continue to broil for 4 minutes. Add the yogurt to the skillet of sauce over low heat. Add the chicken. Continue to cook for 5 minutes without letting the sauce boil. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes, stirring, until wilted. Adjust the seasoning. Diving the chicken and sauce among 4 shallow bowls. Sprinkle with coriander leaves. Serve with basmati rice, if desired.
description: Chicken tikka is a star dish in India. Here we appreciate it all the more when we can make it easily at home. This delicious chicken is marinated in plain 11% yogurt and spices—just enough to give it a good coating and rich taste. Part of the marinade is also used to prepare a hot sauce, flavoured with typical Indian spice blends, like garam masala, with tomato and spinach. It’s a very cozy dish that will warm you up instantly.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Cutlets and Cauliflower
recipeIngredients: 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1/2 tsp ground coriander seeds; 1/2 tsp ground cumin; 1/2 tsp curry powder; 1/2 tsp garlic salt or onion salt; 2 chicken cutlets (see note); 1/3 cauliflower, sliced; 1 cup (25 g) baby spinach; Lemon juice, to taste
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with foil. In a bowl, combine the oil and spices. Season with salt and pepper. On a plate, coat the chicken with 2 tsp (10 ml) of the oil mixture. Let marinate while you cook the cauliflower. On the baking sheet, coat the cauliflower slices with the remaining oil mixture. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Move the cauliflower over to one side of the baking sheet. Place the chicken on the other side of the baking sheet. Continue to bake for 5 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the cauliflower is tender. Finish cooking under the broiler to nicely brown the chicken and cauliflower, if desired. Meanwhile, in the same bowl used to make the oil mixture, place the spinach. Drizzle with lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Serve the chicken and cauliflower on a plate. Top with the spinach. Serve immediately.

title: Oven-Roasted Chicken Legs with Peanut Sauce
recipeIngredients: 6 whole chicken legs, skin on (see note); 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 1 cup (250 ml) coconut milk; 1/2 cup (125 ml) peanut butter; 1/4 cup (60 ml) hoisin sauce; 1 tbsp (15 ml) low-sodium soy sauce; 1 tsp (5 ml) sambal oelek; 1 tsp cornstarch; 1 garlic clove, chopped; 4 cups (100 g) baby spinach; 1/4 cup (10 ml) cilantro leaves; 4 radishes, thinly sliced; 1 Lebanese cucumber, thinly sliced; 1 green onion, thinly sliced; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) low-sodium soy sauce; 2 tsp (10 ml) rice vinegar
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with foil. On a work surface, cut each leg in half to separate the drumstick from the thigh. Place the chicken pieces on the baking sheet and coat with the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for 45 minutes or until the meat easily detaches from the bone. As needed, finish cooking under the broiler for 5 minutes or until the chicken skin has browned. Meanwhile, in a pot, combine all of the ingredients. Bring to a boil while whisking. Simmer for 2 minutes or until the sauce thickens slightly. Keep warm. When ready to serve, in a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Serve the chicken on plates accompanied by the peanut sauce and salad.
description: Oven-Roasted Chicken Legs with Peanut Sauce

title: Grilled Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipeIngredients: 2 tbsp (30 ml) hoisin sauce, plus more for serving; 1 tbsp (15 ml) low-sodium soy sauce; 1	garlic clove, finely grated; 1	lime, zest finely grated; 2 tsp fresh ginger, finely grated ; 2 tsp (10 ml) lime juice; 2 tsp (10 ml) toasted sesame oil ; ¾ lb (340 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs ; 1	large carrot, cut into long ribbons with a vegetable peeler ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) Vietnamese dipping sauce (nuoc cham); 2 tsp (10 ml) lime juice; 8	leaves curly-leaf or Boston lettuce, hard parts removed ; Cilantro and/or mint and/or Thai basil leaves, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients except for the chicken. Season with pepper. Add the chicken and toss to coat in the marinade (see note). Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate. Grill the chicken for 6 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Let rest on a plate for 5 minutes. On a work surface, slice the chicken into strips. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the carrot ribbons with the dipping sauce and lime juice. Let marinate for 5 minutes. Strain the carrots through a sieve placed over a bowl. Set the dipping sauce mixture aside for serving. Place the chicken strips at the centre of the lettuce leaves. Top with the carrot ribbons and herbs. Drizzle with hoisin sauce. Roll up each lettuce leaf to hold in the fillings. Serve the lettuce wraps with the reserved dipping sauce mixture, if desired.
description: In this recipe, soak leftover chicken in an Asian-inspired marinade before cooking. Serve it Vietnamese-style, with carrot ribbons and wrapped in a lettuce leaf.

title: Chicken Fajitas in the Pizza Oven
recipeIngredients: 1 red onion, thinly sliced; 1 red or yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips; 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 1 lb (450 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into strips; 2 tsp chili powder; 1/4 cup (10 g) cilantro leaves; 1 lime, quartered; 8 soft wheat tortillas, each 7 inches (18 cm) in diameter, warmed; 2 cups (200 g) mild orange cheddar cheese, grated; Homemade or store-bought salsa, to taste; Homemade or store-bought guacamole, to taste; Sour cream, to taste
recipeInstructions: Place the cast iron pan in the pizza oven. Preheat the pizza oven on high (MAX) with the door closed for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the onion and bell pepper with 1 tbsp (15 ml) of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. In another bowl, combine the chicken with the chili powder and remaining oil. Season with salt and pepper. Place the chicken on the hot cast iron pan. Watch out for splattering. Bake with the door closed for 4 minutes, stirring halfway through, or until the chicken is cooked. Add the vegetables. Bake with the door closed for another 3 to 5 minutes or until the vegetables are golden, stirring as needed. Remove the pan from the oven. Place the cilantro and lime wedges over the chicken and vegetables. Place the hot pan at the centre of the table (see note) along with the tortillas, cheese, salsa, guacamole and sour cream. Let everyone around the table build their own fajitas.
description: On a busy night, chicken fajitas are always a smart meal choice, given that everyone in the family will approve of this recipe! In the pizza oven, the chicken is cooked until tender and the veggies until golden, and then you can place them, along with the tortillas and toppings, on the patio table for everyone to dig in.

title: Butterflied Chicken in the Pizza Oven
recipeIngredients: 3 tbsp black peppercorns; 1 1/2 tbsp coriander seeds; 2 tbsp salt; 1 1/2 tbsp sweet paprika; 1 1/2 tsp onion powder; 1 chicken, about 3 lb (1.4 kg) (see note); 2 tbsp basic dry rub; 1/2 lemon; Vegetable oil, for brushing
recipeInstructions: In a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle, crush the peppercorns and coriander seeds with the salt. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. The basic dry rub will keep for 3 months in an airtight container at room temperature. On a work surface, using a chef’s knife or kitchen shears, cut out the backbone of the chicken. Open the chicken and spread it out flat. Place the chicken in a large glass baking dish. Sprinkle with the dry rub, then rub with the cut-side of the lemon half. Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours. Place the cast iron pan in the pizza oven. Preheat the pizza oven on high (MAX) with the door closed for 20 minutes. Using a pastry brush, cover a square of foil with oil. Place the chicken on the hot cast iron pan, skin-side up. Watch out for splattering. Cover with the foil, oil-side touching the chicken. Reduce the temperature of the pizza oven to medium (2). Bake with the door closed for 12 minutes. Using the removable handle, rotate the pan 180 degrees. Bake with the door closed for another 12 minutes. Using the removable handle, rotate the pan again. Remove the foil. Bake for another 10 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through, until a thermometer inserted in the thigh without touching bone reads 180°F (82°C). Remove from the oven and let rest on the pan for 5 minutes. Delicious served with green salad.
description: Butterflied (or spatchcocked or flattened) chicken is already a quick way to cook a whole bird. By removing the backbone and spine and then pressing down until flat, you’ve already shaved off quite a few minutes of cooking. And baking the chicken in the pizza oven cuts that down even further, to 35 minutes! With tender, juicy meat and a crispy skin, you won’t want to cook chicken any other way!

title: Chicken Legs with Olives and Walnuts
recipeIngredients: 4 whole chicken legs with skin; 1 lemon, halved; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 2 tsp curry powder ; 4 potatoes, scrubbed clean, cut into long wedges ; 2 garlic cloves, chopped; 1 shallot, chopped; 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1/4 cup (25 g) walnuts, chopped; 2 tbsp oil-packed dried black olives, pitted and chopped ; 2 tbsp green olives, pitted and chopped ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey, plus more for serving; 1/4 cup (10 g) cilantro leaves, finely chopped
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Place the chicken in a large baking dish. Rub the chicken with the cut-side of the lemon halves and the oil. Coat with the curry powder. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange the lemon halves and potatoes around the chicken in the baking dish. Bake for 1 hour 10 minutes or until the chicken easily detaches from the bone and the potatoes are tender. Meanwhile, in a small pot over high heat, cook the garlic, shallot and bell pepper in the oil until nicely browned, stirring a few times, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add the walnuts, olives and honey. Season with salt and pepper. Let cool. Add the cilantro and mix well. Divide the chicken and potatoes among four plates. Garnish the chicken with the olive topping and drizzle with more honey. Drizzle with the roasted lemon. Serve with green vegetables, if desired.
description: Cooking may be long and slow, but the preparation of these chicken thigh is so quick that it’s a good idea to add them to your weeknight rotation. The stars of this recipe are salty olives, honey to sweeten the meat, crunchy walnuts and roasted lemon that season the whole dish. The chicken thigh may stick to your fingers a little…and it’s perfect like this.
