title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Holiday Spices
recipeIngredients: 4 1/2 lb (2 kg) boneless pork shoulder, rind removed, cubed; 2 tbsp butter ; 2 onions, thinly sliced; 4 garlic cloves, chopped; 1/2 cup (125 ml) dry white wine; 1 cup (250 ml) beef broth; 2 tbsp light toasted flour ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) ketchup; 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ; 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg ; 1/4 tsp ground cloves ; 4 cups (340 g) red cabbage, thinly sliced on a mandoline; 1/3 cup (50 g) dried cranberries, chopped; 1/2 cup (25 g) flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped; 8 to 12 radishes, chopped; 1 shallot, thinly sliced; 1/4 cup (60 ml) red wine vinegar; 1 tbsp (15 ml) maple syrup; 24 small brioche hamburger rolls, halved horizontally
recipeInstructions: In a large skillet over high heat, brown half of the meat in half of the butter (1 tbsp) at a time. Season with salt and pepper. Place in a slow cooker. In the same skillet, cook the onions and garlic in the pork cooking fat until lightly browned. Deglaze with the wine and let reduce by half. Add the broth, toasted flour, ketchup and spices. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Transfer to the slow cooker. Cover and cook on High for 6 hours. The pork mixture can be maintained on Warm for up to 4 hours. Using a ladle, remove any excess fat from the pork cooking juices. Using a wooden spoon, shred the pork. Adjust the seasoning. The pulled pork can be maintained on Warm for serving. In a bowl, combine the cabbage, cranberries, parsley, radishes, shallot, vinegar and maple syrup. Season with salt and pepper. Let marinate for 15 minutes. Drain the salad before serving, as needed. Fill the buns with warm pulled pork and the coleslaw.
description: Since it's always easier to eat with your hands, these tiny sandwiches will be welcome at any casual potluck. The pulled pork filling with holiday spices can be made in advance and won't take over the oven (thanks to the slow cooker). At a potluck, create a self-serve station where everyone can load up their brioche buns with the meat and cranberry-radish coleslaw, for a burst of colour and crunch with each bite.

title: Air Fryer Tofu Alla Parmigiana Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1 lb (450 g) firm tofu; 2 tbsp cornstarch ; ½ cup (40 g) panko breadcrumbs; ¼ cup (20 g) fresh Parmesan cheese, finely grated; 1 tsp dried oregano ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil ; ¾ cup (180 ml) store-bought tomato sauce with basil; 1 ½ cups (150 g) mozzarella cheese, grated ; 4 kaiser rolls, halved horizontally; ½ cup (125 ml) store-bought antipasto (mixed marinated vegetables), drained; 2 cups (50 g) arugula
recipeInstructions: On a work surface, cut the block of tofu into 4 large slices. Pat the tofu slices very dry. Season with salt. In a shallow dish, place the cornstarch. In a second shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs, Parmesan and oregano. Gently coat the tofu slices with the cornstarch. Pour the oil into the same dish. Press the tofu into the oil to soak in the cornstarch. Press the tofu into the breadcrumb mixture to coat well on both sides. Place the tofu in the basket of an air fryer. Cook for 20 minutes at 400°F (200°C). Remove the basket from the air fryer. Flip the tofu slices over. Top with the tomato sauce, about 3 tbsp (45 ml) per slice. Sprinkle with the cheese. Continue to cook for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden. Cover the inside of the kaiser rolls with the antipasto. Top the bottoms of the rolls with the tofu. Garnish with the arugula. Close the sandwiches with the tops of the rolls. Cut in half, if desired.
description: This parmigiana-style sandwich includes crispy tofu slices, tomato sauce, mixed antipasto vegetables and arugula all piled into a kaiser roll. A perfect meal for lovers of vegetarian and Italian cuisines.

title: Barbecue Tofu Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1 block (350 g) extra-firm tofu; ⅓ cup (45 g) cornstarch; ⅓ cup (75 ml) homemade or store-bought barbecue sauce; 2 cups (170 g) red cabbage, thinly sliced; ¼ cup (30 g) carrots, julienned ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) whole-grain mustard; 2 tbsp (30 ml) apple cider vinegar; 2 tbsp (30 ml) maple syrup; 1 green onion, thinly sliced; 4 brioche hamburger buns, toasted; ⅓ cup (75 ml) homemade or store-bought barbecue sauce
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet with the oil. Place two layers of paper towels on a work surface. Place the tofu on the paper towels and cover with another two layers of paper towels. Press with your hands to absorb all of the water. Change the paper towels as needed. Cut the tofu into 16 slices. Place the cornstarch on a plate. Dredge the tofu slices in the cornstarch and place them on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, flipping the slices over halfway through cooking. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Using a pastry brush, coat the tofu slices with the barbecue sauce on both sides. Continue baking for 10 minutes or until the sauce begins to caramelize slightly. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Cover the inside of the toasted buns with the barbecue sauce. Place 4 slices of tofu on each bun bottom. Top with the coleslaw. Close with the bun tops and serve immediately.
description: In this recipe, slices of tofu are dredged in cornstarch and browned on both sides in the oven on a baking sheet. We then generously coat the slices in barbecue sauce and return them to the oven to let them caramelize and crisp up even further. We serve the tofu slices on hamburger buns garnished with coleslaw and green onion.

title: Fish & Chips-Style Tofu Sandwich
recipeIngredients: ⅓ cup (75 ml) mayonnaise; ⅓ cup (75 ml) 5% plain Greek yogurt ; 2 tbsp dill pickles, cut into small dice ; 1 shallot, finely chopped; 1 tbsp capers, drained and chopped ; 1 tbsp dill, finely chopped; 1 tsp (5 ml) lemon juice; Cayenne pepper, to taste; ½ cup (125 ml) dill pickle juice; 1 lemon, zest finely grated ; 1 block (350 g) extra-firm tofu, halved lengthwise, then halved widthwise ; 1 ¼ cups (190 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 2 tbsp cornstarch ; 1 tsp salt; ½ tsp baking powder ; 1 cup (250 ml) blonde ale, cold; Vegetable oil, for frying; 4 milk, kaiser or ciabatta buns, halved horizontally, toasted; Iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate. In a shallow bowl, combine the pickle juice and lemon zest. Season with salt. Set the marinade aside. Place two layers of paper towels on a work surface. Place the tofu on the paper towels and cover with another two layers of paper towels. Press with your hands to absorb all of the water. Change the paper towels as needed. Soak the tofu pieces in the marinade for 5 minutes on each side, turning them over gently (see note). Preheat the oil in a deep fryer to 350°F (180°C). Place a wire rack over a baking sheet. In a bowl, combine ¾ cup (115 g) of the flour with the cornstarch, salt and baking powder. Add the beer and whisk until the batter is smooth. Place the remaining flour in a shallow bowl. Drain the tofu pieces from the marinade and dredge in the flour, gently shaking off any excess. Dip one piece of tofu at a time in the beer batter and coat well. Fry two pieces of tofu at a time for 5 minutes or until the batter is golden, shaking the fryer basket to prevent them from sticking to the bottom. Watch out for splattering. Remove the tofu from the fryer and drain on the wire rack. Season with salt. Cover the inside of the toasted buns with the tartare sauce. Top the bun bottoms with the fried tofu. Garnish with lettuce. Close with the bun tops and serve immediately.
description: For this fast food-inspired recipe, we use thick-cut slices of tofu to give the illusion of generous pieces of fish. The tofu is thoroughly soaked in a marinade of flavourful pickle juice, dredged in flour and then plunged into a beer batter all before being fried to perfection. We serve this up on buns slathered with homemade tartare sauce.

title: Japanese-Style Crispy Sesame Tofu Sandwiches (Onigirazu)
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (430 g) Calrose rice (sushi rice); 2 cups (500 ml) cold water ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) rice vinegar; 1 tbsp sugar ; ½ tsp salt ; 1 block (350 g) extra-firm tofu; 1 egg; ½ cup (40 g) panko breadcrumbs; 3 tbsp roasted black and white sesame seeds, plus more for assembly ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) vegetable oil; 6 nori sheets; 1 cup (25 g) baby spinach; 3 Lebanese cucumbers, thinly sliced on a mandoline; 1 large ripe avocado, thinly sliced
recipeInstructions:
Rinse the rice under cold running water until the water runs clear. Drain well. In a pot, bring the rice and water to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 12 to 15 minutes or until the water has been completely absorbed by the rice. Remove from the heat and let rest for 5 minutes, covered. Remove the lid and fluff the grains of rice with a fork (see note). In a small bowl, combine the rice vinegar, sugar and salt until the sugar and salt have dissolved. Pour the mixture over the cooked rice and stir gently to coat well. Let cool. Meanwhile, on a work surface, cut the tofu in half lengthwise. Cut each half block of tofu in three widthwise to get a total of six 3-inch (7.5 cm) square slices. Place two layers of paper towels on the work surface. Place the tofu on the paper towels and cover with another two layers of paper towels. Press with your hands to absorb all of the water. Change the paper towels as needed. Season the tofu with salt. Beat the egg in a shallow bowl. In a second shallow bowl, combine the breadcrumbs and sesame seeds. Dip the tofu slices into the beaten egg, letting some of the excess drip off. Press into the breadcrumb mixture to coat well. In a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook half of the tofu slices at a time in the oil for 3 minutes on each side or until nicely browned. Add more oil as needed. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels.  On a work surface, place a nori sheet matt-side up with one corner pointing down. With slightly wet hands (see note), place ⅓ cup (75 ml) of the rice at the centre of the nori sheet, shaping it into a 3-inch (7.5 cm) square. Top the rice with one-sixth of the spinach, and one-sixth of the cucumber and avocado slices. Cover with one slice of tofu. Top with another ⅓ cup (75 ml) rice, shaping it into a square. Wet the corners of the nori sheet. Fold the four corners of the nori sheet over the rice to close into a sandwich. Repeat these steps with the remaining nori sheets, rice, vegetables and tofu.
 Cut the sandwiches in half (see note). Sprinkle the cut-side of the sandwiches with sesame seeds. Serve with soy sauce, tamari sauce, katsu sauce or spicy mayonnaise, if desired.
description: These sandwiches are like a giant piece of sushi with the addition of katsu-style tofu. Cut into thick slices, the tofu is coated in a mixture of panko and sesame seeds, then browned in a skillet. Along with rice, spinach, cucumber and avocado slices, the tofu is wrapped in a nori sheet and covered with plastic wrap to hold everything in place as needed.

title: Neapolitan Sandwiches in the Pizza Oven
recipeIngredients: 1/3 cup (75 ml) olive oil; 3 tbsp fresh Parmesan cheese, grated; 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped; 2 tsp rosemary, finely chopped; 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes; 4 balls pizza dough (by hand) ; 1 cup (250 ml) ricotta cheese, at room temperature ; 1/4 cup (35 g) unsalted shelled pistachios, chopped; 1 lemon, zest finely grated; 1/2 lb (225 g) pistachio mortadella, thinly sliced (see note) ; 2 cups (50 g) arugula
recipeInstructions: Preheat the pizza oven on high (3) with the door closed for 20 minutes. In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. On a floured work surface, roll out one ball of pizza dough at a time into a 10-inch (25 cm) circle. Remove any excess flour. Place the dough on a lightly floured pizza peel.  Using a brush, spread some of the Parmesan oil over the dough. Fold the dough in half and place it on a lightly floured pizza peel. Using the pizza peel, slide one pizza at a time onto the hot stone. Bake in the pizza oven for 2 to 3 minutes, rotating the pizza 4 or 5 times during cooking, or until the crust is nicely browned. Once out of the oven, on a work surface, unfold the dough without breaking it. Spread more Parmesan oil. Fill each pizza sandwich with ricotta, pistachios, lemon zest, mortadella and arugula. Close the sandwich. Cut in two and serve.
description: Here’s our sandwich version of our mortadella pizza recipe cooked in the pizza oven. Trending on social media recently, it consists of making a sandwich by folding pizza dough in half rather than using bread.

title: Shrimp Toast
recipeIngredients: 1/4 cup (10 g) cilantro stems and leaves ; 1 green onion, cut into pieces; 1 garlic clove, halved; 6 oz (170 g) shelled shrimp, thawed and patted very dry (see note) ; 1 egg; 2 tsp (10 ml) low-sodium soy sauce; 1 tsp (5 ml) sambal oelek; 1/3 cup (50 g) sesame seeds (see note); 4 slices sandwich bread; 3/4 cup (180 ml) vegetable oil, for cooking
recipeInstructions: In a food processor, chop the cilantro, green onion and garlic. Add the shrimp, egg, soy sauce, sesame oil and sambal. Blend until coarsely puréed. Season with salt and pepper. Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the food processor as needed.  Place the sesame seeds in a shallow bowl. On a work surface, spread the shrimp purée over the bread, using about ¼ cup per slice. Working with one slice of bread at a time, press shrimp-side down into the sesame seeds. On a work surface, cut each slice of bread into 4 triangles. In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, warm the oil for 5 minutes. Brown half of the bread triangles at a time in the oil, shrimp-side down, for 3 to 4 minutes. Flip over and continue to cook until the bread is golden, about 1 minute. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels. Serve with store-bought sweet chili sauce, if desired.
description: Popular in Asia, Hong Kong-style shrimp toasts are a delicacy of fusion cuisine. The recipe consists of a shrimp filling enhanced with herbs and condiments, which is then spread on slices of bread. A layer of sesame seeds covers the shrimp, adding a crunchy texture to the fried toasts. They're sure to be a hit!

title: Muffuletta Picnic Sandwich
recipeIngredients: 2 red bell peppers, each cut into 3 pieces and seeded; 3 zucchini, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch (5 mm) thick slices; 1 large eggplant, about 3/4 lb (340 g), cut into 1/4-inch (5 mm) thick slices; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) balsamic vinegar; 1 loaf round Italian bread, about 8 inches (20 cm) in diameter; 1/4 cup (60 ml) ajvar spread (see note); 3 oz (85 g) mortadella slices; 2 oz (55 g) calabrese sausage slices; 1/2 cup (20 g) fresh basil leaves
recipeInstructions: Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate. Grill the bell peppers for about 5 minutes on each side or until they are tender and charred. Place in an airtight container, close the lid and let cool for 5 minutes. Peel the skins. Meanwhile, grill the zucchini for 2 to 3 minutes and the eggplant for 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until tender. Place the vegetables in a large dish. Let cool. Add the peeled peppers. Drizzle the vegetables with the oil and vinegar. Season with salt and pepper, and toss well. Set aside. On a work surface, cut off the top of the bread loaf with a bread knife. Hollow out the loaf by removing about 4 cups of the crumb, leaving about a ½-inch (1.5 cm) thick crust. Keep the crumb for another use. Set aside. Spread the ajvar inside the loaf and on the cut side of the bread top. Evenly layer the mortadella, calabrese, vegetables and basil inside the bread. Close the loaf with the bread top. Cover with aluminum foil or plastic wrap and place on a plate. Weigh down with cans or plates directly placed on the loaf and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Leave the muffuletta at room temperature for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Peanut Butter and Jam French Toast Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 2	eggs; ½ cup (125 ml) milk; 2 tbsp sugar ; 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla ; ½ tsp ground cinnamon ; 8	slices white sandwich bread ; ¼ cup (60 ml) strawberry or raspberry jam ; ¼ cup (60 ml) peanut butter ; 2 tbsp butter ; Maple syrup, for serving
recipeInstructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon. On a work surface, spread the jam over 4 slices of bread and the peanut butter over the remaining 4 slices. Close the sandwiches. Dip one sandwich at a time in the egg mixture, letting it soak in. Place the sandwiches on a plate while you prepare to cook them. Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Melt half of the butter in the skillet. Place two sandwiches at a time in the skillet and brown for 2 minutes on each side, flipping them over with a spatula. Keep the sandwiches warm on a baking sheet in an oven preheated to 200°F (95°C) while you cook the remaining sandwiches in the remaining butter, or serve them as you go. Serve with maple syrup.
description: Peanut butter and jelly are the classic sweet and salty lunchtime combo. As a golden French toast sandwich, no one will believe how few ingredients and steps this recipe requires!

title: Giant Maple Ham Sandwich with Sesame Coleslaw
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (170 g) Savoy cabbage, thinly sliced; 1 carrot, julienned; 1 green onion, thinly sliced; 3 tbsp cilantro, plus more for serving ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) mayonnaise, plus more for serving; 1 tsp (5 ml) maple syrup; 1 tsp (5 ml) sesame oil; 1 tsp (5 ml) low-sodium soy sauce; 1/2 recipe maple and ginger-braised ham, thinly sliced (see recipe) ; 1 large Parisian-style baguette ; 3 tbsp roasted peanuts, chopped ; 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds ; 1/2 jalapeño chili pepper, seeded or unseeded, thinly sliced
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with pepper. In a large skillet over medium heat, warm the ham with its sauce. Drain the ham and onions well. Discard the sauce or save for another use. On a work surface, cut the baguette in half horizontally. Cover the inside of the bread with mayonnaise. Top with the warm ham and onions, and the coleslaw. Sprinkle with the peanuts, sesame seeds, cilantro leaves and jalapeño slices. Close the sandwich. Cut into 4 or 6 servings. Serve immediately.
description: To make this giant sandwich, take a whole baguette and fill it with our maple and ginger-braised ham, then top with an Asian-inspired slaw with sesame and roasted peanuts. It's a sandwich made for sharing for your next gathering with family or friends.

title: Butternut Squash Toasts with Sweet and Sour Sauce (Agrodolce)
recipeIngredients: 1 medium butternut squash, peeled, halved and seeded; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 8 slices sharp cheddar cheese; 4 slices multi-grain bread, ¾ inch (2 cm) thick, toasted; 2 cups (50 g) arugula ; 1 shallot, thinly sliced; 2 shallots, finely chopped; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 1/2 cup (125 ml) apple cider vinegar ; 1/4 cup (40 g) pumpkin seeds; 1/4 cup (35 g) golden raisins or other raisins ; 1 tbsp capers ; 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup ; 3 tbsp unsalted butter
recipeInstructions: With one rack in the upper third and another rack in the lower third, preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line two baking sheets with silicone mats or parchment paper. On a work surface, cut the squash into slices ¼ inch (5 mm) thick. In a bowl, toss the squash slices with the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Spread the squash slices out over the two baking sheets. Bake for 20 minutes or until tender and golden. Meanwhile, in a small pot over medium heat, soften the shallots in the oil until starting to brown slightly. Add the vinegar and let reduce by half, about 4 minutes. Add the pumpkin seeds, raisins, capers and red pepper flakes to the pot. Mix well. Add the syrup. Simmer for 4 minutes or until the sauce is thick and syrupy. Add the butter and stir until smooth. Season with salt. Place two slices of cheese on each slice of toasted bread. Top with the arugula, squash and shallot. Cover with the sauce. Serve immediately.
description: Agrodolce is an Italian condiment that means sweet and sour. In Italy, it’s made with honey, red wine vinegar, fruits and sometimes pine nuts. Our recipe is adapted for our pantry, using maple syrup, cider vinegar, raisins, pumpkin seeds and a good quantity of capers. Serve this sweet and tangy sauce still warm over a piece of toast garnished with roasted squash, cheddar and arugula.

title: Chicken Shawarma Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) plain Greek yogurt ; 3 garlic cloves, finely grated; 1 lemon, zest finely grated and juiced ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) tomato paste ; 2 tsp ground cumin ; 2 tsp sweet paprika ; 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ; 1 1/2 (675 g) boneless, RICARDO Mediterranean-Style Chicken Breasts (see note); 1 red onion, cut into 8 wedges ; 4 pita breads ; 2 cups (60 g) romaine lettuce leaves, thinly sliced ; 1 tomato, cut into halfmoons
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with foil. In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, garlic, lemon zest and juice. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside ½ cup (125 ml) of the yogurt mixture in a small bowl and refrigerate until ready to assemble the sandwiches. Add the oil, tomato paste and spices to the large bowl of yogurt. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Add the chicken and toss well to coat. Place the onion wedges on one side of the baking sheet. Toss with oil. Season with salt and pepper. Spread the chicken mixture out on the other side of the baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Set the onion aside on a plate. Using a fork, shred the chicken on another plate. Return the chicken to the baking sheet. Preheat the oven to broil. Bake the chicken until some pieces are crispy, about 5 to 6 minutes. On a work surface, open the pitas and gently separate the two sides to get a total of 8 discs. For each sandwich, place two pita halves on the work surface, overlapping them slightly. Cover with the reserved garlic yogurt. Top with the lettuce, tomato, chicken and onion. Firmly roll up without closing the extremities. Serve immediately.
description: To recreate the good taste of chicken shawarma in a quick version, coat chicken thighs with a marinade made of yogurt, garlic, lemon and spices. Cook it on a baking sheet in the oven. Serve the chicken in pita bread with garlic yogurt, lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Sausage, Spinach and Cheese Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 4 mild or spicy Italian sausages, casings removed ; 1 small red onion, thinly sliced; 4 cups (100 g) baby spinach ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil ; 1 garlic clove, finely grated ; 4 panini buns, each about 7 inches (18 cm) long ; 8 slices mozzarella cheese; Mixed vegetable antipasto or marinated hot peppers, to taste
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Using your fingers, crumble the sausage meat over the baking sheet. Spread the onion out over the meat. Bake for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the spinach, oil and garlic. Season with salt and pepper. On a work surface, cut the buns in half horizontally without going all the way through to the other side. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Cover the inside of the buns with the sausage mixture. Place the buns on the baking sheet. Divide the spinach mixture among the breads, pressing down lightly. Place 2 slices of cheese on each sandwich. Bake in the oven for 3 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Top with the antipasto and close the sandwiches. Serve with green salad, if desired. Serve immediately.
description: This original sandwich puts the spotlight on Italian sausage flesh, crumbled instead of using them whole. Also add spinach and mozzarella melted on top of the sandwich under the broiler. Serve this warm sandwich on a weeknight and the whole family will be thrilled.

title: Open-Faced Cilantro Roast Pork Loin Sandwiches with Pineapple Chutney
recipeIngredients: 1 onion, chopped; 1 cup (145 g) fresh pineapple, diced; 1 cup (140 g) cherry tomatoes, various colours, quartered ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) rice vinegar ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) water; 6 tbsp (90 ml) maple syrup ; 1/2 cup (25 g) cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped; 1 jalapeño chili pepper, seeded or not, chopped ; 1 garlic clove, crushed; 1 lemon, zest finely grated and juiced; 6 tbsp (90 ml) olive oil ; 1 boneless pork loin roast, about 2.2 lb (1 kg), untied ; 8 thick slices brioche bread, toasted; Whole-grain mustard, to taste ; Arugula, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a pot, bring all of the ingredients to a boil while stirring often. Simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes or until the liquid is syrupy. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer into a bowl and let cool. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. The chutney will keep for 2 weeks in an airtight container in the refrigerator. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Meanwhile, in a small food processor, purée the cilantro, jalapeño, garlic, lemon zest and juice, and oil until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside 6 tbsp (90 ml) of the marinade in a small bowl until ready to serve. Place the pork roast in a glass baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Coat with the remaining marinade. Bake for 45 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the centre of the roast reads 135°F (57°C). Transfer the roast to a plate. Cover with foil and let rest for at least 10 minutes. The temperature should increase to 145°F (63°C) (see note). When ready to serve, on a work surface, thinly slice the pork. Drizzle with the cooking juices. Cover the toasted brioche with mustard. Top with the sliced pork and pineapple chutney. Garnish with arugula and cilantro leaves. Drizzle with the reserved marinade.
description: This variation on the crusty pies of the holidays takes you away from the ordinary. Stuff these turnovers with a mixture of ground pork, thyme and fennel seeds, adding blue cheese and fig jam before closing the little packages and baking them in the oven. This refined dish is perfect for this occasion and its original flavours will make an impact.

title: Air Fryer Open-Faced Reuben Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 1 tbsp (15 ml) ketchup; 1 tbsp (15 ml) prepared yellow mustard ; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) Worcestershire sauce; 1 small shallot, finely chopped; 4 slices rye bread ; 1 cup (250 ml) store-bought sauerkraut, drained; 3/4 lb (340 g) sliced smoked meat ; 8 sour gherkins, halved lengthwise ; 8 slices Swiss cheese; Dill fronds, for serving (optional)
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Set aside. Place 2 slices of bread at a time in the basket of an air fryer. Cook for 2 minutes at 375°F (190°C) (see note). Place the toasted bread on a work surface. Cover with the sauce. Top with the sauerkraut, smoked meat, gherkins and cheese. Place 2 open-faced sandwiches at a time in the basket of the air fryer. Cook for 8 minutes at 375°F (190°C) or until the meat is hot and the cheese has melted (see note). Sprinkle with dill fronds and serve immediately.
description: A cousin of the smoked meat sandwich, the Reuben is served between slices of toasted bread with a creamy ketchup and mustard sauce, as well as melting Swiss cheese. Served on toast, it’s the ideal format for the air fryer.

title: Porchetta and Asparagus Croque Madame with Cheddar Mornay Sauce
recipeIngredients: 1 tbsp butter ; 1 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 1 cup (100 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated ; 1	egg yolk ; 1	pinch ground nutmeg; 4	slices square brioche bread; 5 oz (170 g) porchetta or white ham, thinly sliced ; 1 lb (450 g) asparagus, trimmed and blanched ; 1 ¼ cups (125 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated; 1 tbsp butter; 4 eggs; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 2 tsp (10 ml) whole-grain mustard; 6 cups (140 g) mesclun lettuce (see note); 3	radishes, various colours, thinly sliced on a mandoline
recipeInstructions: In a pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute while whisking. Add the milk. Bring to a boil while whisking constantly. Cook for another 2 minutes or until the mixture thickens. Remove from the heat. Add the cheese, egg yolk and nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper. Mix just until the cheese has melted. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the bread slices on the baking sheet. Cover each slice with 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the Mornay sauce. Top with the sliced porchetta and asparagus. Add the remaining Mornay sauce and sprinkle with the cheese (see note). Bake for 15 minutes or until the cheese is nicely browned. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, honey and mustard. Season with salt and pepper. When ready to serve, add the mesclun and radishes. Mix well. In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, melt the butter. Carefully crack the eggs directly into the skillet and cook, on one side only, for 3 minutes or until the whites are set. Season with salt and pepper. Using a spatula, place one egg over each slice of baked bread. Serve with the salad. Serve immediately.
description: Croque madame is an essential brunch dish. Inspired by the one we serve at Café RICARDO restaurants, this gourmet version is even more decadent than the original. As all the steps can be done in advance, it's the ideal dish for entertaining at home. All you have to do is assemble and reheat your croque madame and cook the eggs at the last minute.

title: Grilled Zucchini and Marinated White Bean Toasts
recipeIngredients: 1 can (19 oz/540 ml) white beans, rinsed and drained; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped; 2 tbsp oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and finely chopped ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) red wine vinegar; 1 lemon, zest finely grated; 1 shallot, finely chopped; 1 garlic clove, finely chopped; 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes; 1/2 cup (125 ml) ricotta cheese; 1 lemon, zest finely grated; 4 slices country bread, each about 3/4 inch (2 cm) thick; 2 zucchini, cut into long slices 1/8 inch (3 mm) thick; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil; Fleur de sel
recipeInstructions: Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate. In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season generously with salt and pepper. Set aside (see note). In another bowl, combine the ricotta and lemon zest. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. On a baking sheet, coat the bread and zucchini slices with the oil. Season the zucchini with salt and pepper. Grill half of the zucchini slices at a time for 2 minutes on each side or until tender. Grill the bread for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Spread the bread out on a work surface. Top the bread with the ricotta mixture. Divide the marinated beans and grilled zucchini among the bread slices. Sprinkle fleur de sel over the zucchini. Cut the toasts in half, if desired. Serve immediately. Serve with green salad, if desired.
description: This recipe highlights each ingredient beautifully, starting with the white beans, which are marinated with parsley, sundried tomatoes, red wine vinegar and garlic, for a big burst of flavour. The zucchini are sliced into ribbons and softened on the grill, and the lemony ricotta brings freshness to the whole. A refined garnish for toasted country bread that makes for fancy open-faced sandwiches.

title: Barbecue Pork Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced into thin rounds on a mandoline; 1 tbsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar; 1 tsp (5 ml) honey; 1 pork tenderloin, about 3/4 lb (340 g); 2 tsp Montreal steak spice ; 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 8 wedges ; 1 red onion, cut into rounds 1/2 inch (1.5 cm) thick; 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 8 slices sesame and sunflower bread, each about 1/2 inch (1.5 cm) thick (see note); 1/3 cup (75 ml) mayonnaise; 1/4 cup (60 ml) store-bought barbecue sauce
recipeInstructions: Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate. In a bowl, combine the cucumber, vinegar and honey. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. On a baking sheet, coat the pork tenderloin with the steak spice. Arrange the vegetables around the pork. Coat the pork and vegetables with the oil. Season the vegetables with salt and pepper. Place the pork on the grill. Reduce the temperature of the barbecue to medium. Cook the pork for 15 minutes, turning it over a few times, until a thermometer inserted in the centre of the meat reads 135°F (57°C). Set aside on a plate and let rest for 10 minutes. At the same time, grill the vegetables until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Set aside on another plate and let cool. Grill the slices of bread. On a work surface, thinly slice the pork. Spread the mayonnaise and barbecue sauce over the toasted bread. Divide the grilled vegetables, sliced pork and marinated cucumbers among 4 slices of bread. Close the sandwiches with the remaining bread.
description: In the summer, we love to fill up on local products, including veggies from the farmers market, but also pork and fresh bread. Combine all of these economical ingredients in a sandwich that features almost only barbecued elements with pickled cucumbers garnish. A simple dinner at its best.

title: Vegetarian Tempeh Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 3 tbsp (45 ml) low-sodium soy sauce ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup; 1 tbsp smoked paprika ; 2 tsp (10 ml) apple cider vinegar; 1 package (240 g) tempeh, cut into 16 slices each 1/8 inch (3 mm) thick ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 8 slices crusty bread, toasted ; Mayonnaise, to taste; Iceberg lettuce leaves, torn ; Basil leaves, to taste; 2 avocados, ripe but firm, thinly sliced ; 2 tomatoes, sliced
recipeInstructions: In a shallow bowl, combine the soy sauce, maple syrup, paprika and vinegar. Coat the tempeh slices in the marinade. Drain and set the marinade aside. In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook the tempeh in the oil until nicely browned, about 5 minutes. Season with pepper. Flip the tempeh over and cook for 1 more minute. Add the reserved marinade and let reduce until almost dry. Cover the slices of bread with mayonnaise. Divide the lettuce, basil, avocados, tomatoes and tempeh among 4 slices of bread. Close the sandwiches with the remaining bread. Cut the sandwiches in half and serve immediately.
description: Revisit the BLT with this vegetarian option. Spread mayonnaise on two slices of bread, then top them with avocado and tomato. Marinated and grilled slices of tempeh add a crunchy dose of protein to the sandwich. This is a perfect small lunch, boosted by the sweet saltiness of the marinade and freshness of the vegetables. A single bite will convince even the biggest lovers of this classic sandwich that the veggie version can be just as great.

title: Pork Stir-Fry Lettuce Wraps (San Choy Bow)
recipeIngredients: 1 1/2 lb (675 g) lean ground pork ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil; 4 oz (115 g) shiitake mushrooms, thinly sliced; 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped; 1 tbsp fresh ginger, finely chopped ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) oyster sauce; 2 tbsp (30 ml) low-sodium soy sauce ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) sesame oil; 2 tsp sugar ; 2 tsp (10 ml) rice vinegar; 4 cups (180 g) curly-leaf lettuce leaves; 2 green onions, thinly sliced; 1 carrot, julienned; 1/2 cup (20 g) cilantro leaves and stems ; 1/4 cup (40 g) roasted peanuts, chopped; Sambal oelek or store-bought chili oil, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a large non-stick skillet over high heat, cook half of the pork at a time in the oil, breaking the meat up with a wooden spoon, until starting to brown, about 8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the pork from the skillet and place in a bowl. Set aside. In the same skillet, cook the mushrooms in the pork cooking fat until nicely browned and slightly crispy. Add the garlic and ginger. Cook for 1 minute while stirring. Return the meat to the skillet. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Continue to cook just until the sauce is thick and syrupy. Adjust the seasoning. Place the meat mixture, lettuce, green onions, carrot, cilantro, peanuts and sambal at the centre of the table. Let everyone garnish their own lettuce leaves with the toppings.
description: Transform dinnertime into a festive moment serving the meal family style. Use this slightly sweet ground pork and shiitake mushroom stir-fry, inspired by Chinese cuisine, to put a new twist on taco night. Swap the tortillas for lettuce leaves and let everyone choose their own toppings. Break the routine and bring everyone around the table with this fun weeknight meal.

title: Pulled Tofu Sliders
recipeIngredients: 1 lb (450 g) firm tofu, patted dry and grated; 1/3 cup (45 g) cornstarch; 1 tsp sweet paprika; 1 tsp ground cumin ; 1/2 tsp ground chipotle chili pepper (optional); 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 6 tbsp (90 ml) ketchup; 3 tbsp (45 ml) maple syrup; 1/2 tsp sweet paprika; 1/2 tsp ground cumin ; 1/2 tsp ground chipotle chili pepper (optional); 12 mini brioche hamburger buns, pulled apart and cut in half horizontally, warm (see note); 1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced into thin rounds; 1 cup (30 g) cilantro leaves
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). In a large bowl, combine the tofu with the cornstarch and spices. Season generously with salt and pepper. Pour the oil onto a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet. Spread the tofu mixture out on the baking sheet, lightly coating it in the oil. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove the baking sheet from the oven. Stir the tofu with a spatula. Bake for another 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in the same large bowl, combine the ketchup, maple syrup and spices. Season with salt and pepper. Add the baked tofu to the bowl and mix well. Adjust the seasoning. Divide the tofu mixture among the bun bottoms. Top with the cucumber slices and cilantro leaves. Close with the bun tops. Serve with fresh vegetable crudité, if desired.
description: The main appeal of tofu in this recipe is that it can be made super crunchy, while soaking up all the sauce. This dish uses it grated as a garnish on a little bun, evoking the flavour of pulled pork, minus the cooking time and price! Barbecue sauce made with condiments from the fridge brings the finishing touch. Anything to make back-to-school nights simpler!

title: Buffalo Cauliflower Pitas
recipeIngredients: 1 cauliflower, about 2 lb (900 g), cut into small florets; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 1 tsp sweet paprika ; 1/2 tsp onion powder; 1/2 tsp garlic powder; 1/3 cup (75 ml) hot sauce (Frank’s RedHot-style); 3/4 cup (180 ml) 2% Greek yogurt; 1 lime, zest finely grated ; 6 radishes, cut into thin slices ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lime juice; 4 thick pita breads (see note), halved; 2 Lebanese cucumbers, cut into long ribbons; 1 iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced; Mint leaves, to taste (optional)
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the cauliflower, oil and spices. Season with salt and pepper. Spread the cauliflower out on the baking sheet. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden, stirring halfway through cooking. Pour the hot sauce into the same large bowl. Add the cooked cauliflower and toss well to coat in the sauce. Meanwhile, in another bowl, combine the yogurt and lime zest. Season with salt and pepper. In a third bowl, combine the radishes and lime juice. Season with salt. Spread the yogurt mixture over the inside of the pita halves, on one side only. Fill with the cauliflower, radishes, cucumbers and lettuce. Garnish with the mint leaves.
description: Feel like a vegetarian meal that’s anything but boring? Garnish pita bread with spiced cauliflower coated in a hot sauce. Spread some lime yogurt over the bread and top with crunchy veggies for a delicious lunch or dinner.

title: Smash Burger Tacos
recipeIngredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) mayonnaise; 1/4 cup (40 g) onion, finely chopped; 1 tbsp (15 ml) store-bought French dressing (orange-coloured); 1 tbsp (15 ml) sweet relish; 1 tbsp dill pickle, finely chopped; 1 tsp brown sugar; 1 tsp (5 ml) ketchup; 1 tsp (5 ml) white vinegar; 1/2 lb (225 g) medium-lean ground beef; 1/4 cup (40 g) onion, finely chopped; 1/2 tsp garlic salt; 4soft wheat tortillas, each about 8 inches (20 cm) in diameter; 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil; 4slices orange cheese; 1 cup (60 g) iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced; Dill pickle, finely chopped, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate. The sauce will keep for 1 week in an airtight container in the refrigerator. In a bowl, combine the meat, onion and garlic salt. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the meat mixture among the tortillas, about ¼ cup (60 ml) per taco. Lightly press on the mixture to cover the surface of the tortillas and to ensure that it sticks. Lightly oil two non-stick skillets. Over medium heat, cook one taco at a time in each skillet, meat-side down, for 2 minutes. Press on the tortillas with a spatula to release the juices from the meat. Flip the tacos over and top each one with a slice of cheese. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the cheese is melted. Garnish the hot tacos with the sauce, lettuce and chopped pickles. Fold the tacos over and serve immediately.
description: Taco burgers enjoyed instant popularity on TikTok, so we wanted to create our own version of this recipe inspired by smash burgers. Press the raw ground beef on tortillas, then fry the tacos in a pan, meat side first. The toppings complete the dish: a slice of melted cheese, a sweet and sour sauce made with mayonnaise, French dressing and ketchup, some lettuce and pickle slices. A fun nod to American-style burgers that’ll put a smile on everyone’s face!

title: Cheddar, Apple and Bacon Grilled Cheese
recipeIngredients: 2 slices square bread; 4 tsp (20 ml) apple butter; 1/3 cup (35 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated ; 1/4 Honeycrisp apple, cored and thinly sliced ; 2 slices cooked bacon, halved ; 1 tbsp butter, softened
recipeInstructions: Preheat a mini electric sandwich maker for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cover one side of each slice of bread with the apple butter. Cover one slice of bread with the cheese, apple slices and bacon. Top with the remaining slice of bread. Cover the outside of the sandwich with the butter. Place the sandwich in the sandwich maker. Close the machine and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted. Cut the sandwich in half. Serve immediately.

title: Tuna Melt
recipeIngredients: 1 can (3 1/2 oz/99 g) oil-packed solid tuna, drained ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) mayonnaise, plus more for spreading; 1 tbsp sour gherkins, cut into small dice, plus more for serving ; 1 tbsp dill, finely chopped; 1 tsp (5 ml) whole-grain mustard ; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) sambal oelek; 3 slices Monterey Jack cheese; 2 slices sandwich bread
recipeInstructions: Preheat a mini electric sandwich maker for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the tuna, mayonnaise, gherkins, dill, mustard and sambal oelek. Season with salt and pepper. On a work surface, place half of the cheese on 1 slice of bread. Cover the cheese with the tuna mixture and top with the remaining cheese. Close the sandwich. Generously cover the outside of the sandwich with mayonnaise. Place the sandwich in the sandwich maker. Close the machine and cook for 6 minutes or until the bread is nicely browned. Cut the sandwich in half. Serve with small gherkins, if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Tofu Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped (see note); 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 1 lime, zest finely grated; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lime juice; o	1 lb (450 g) firm tofu, cut into 8 slices; 3 cups (180 g) iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced; 8 radishes, grated ; 2 green onions, chopped; 1/4 cup (10 g) cilantro, finely chopped; 1/4 cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lime juice; 4 hamburger buns or other buns; 1 tomato, cut into 4 slices
recipeInstructions: In a glass dish, combine the peppers, oil, honey, lime zest and juice. Add the tofu and coat well in the marinade. Cover. Let marinate for 15 minutes. Drain the tofu and set the marinade aside.  Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate.  Grill the tofu for 2 minutes on each side. Toast the buns, if desired. Keep warm. In a bowl, combine the lettuce, radishes, green onions, cilantro, mayonnaise, lime juice and the reserved marinade. Season with salt and pepper. title: Mushroom Toasts with Porcini Mayonnaise
recipeIngredients: 2 packages (14 g each) dried porcini or bolete mushrooms, finely chopped ; 1/2 cup (125 ml) warm water; 1/3 cup (75 ml) mayonnaise; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) lemon juice; 1/2 lb (225 g) white mushrooms, sliced; 5 oz (140 g) white or brown shimeji mushrooms, stems trimmed (see note) ; 1 garlic clove, finely chopped; 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil; 2 tbsp chives, finely chopped ; 1/2 ciabatta baguette, cut in half horizontally, each half cut into 2 pieces ; 1/2 lb (225 g) asparagus, trimmed ; 4 hard-boiled eggs, cut into small wedges; 1 lemon, quartered
recipeInstructions: Place the porcini mushrooms in a bowl. Cover with the water and let soak for 30 minutes at room temperature. Place a fine sieve over a bowl. Drain the mushrooms in the sieve, pressing down with the back of a spoon to extract as much water as possible. Set the soaking water aside. In a small food processor, purée half of the porcini mushrooms with the mayonnaise and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Set the remaining porcini mushrooms aside. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the white mushrooms, shimeji mushrooms and garlic in 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the oil until golden. Add the reserved porcini mushrooms and soaking water. Continue to cook until the water has evaporated. Add the chives. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Set aside. Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high, or heat a ridged skillet over high heat. Brush the pieces of bread and the asparagus with the remaining oil. Grill the bread and asparagus for 5 minutes or until the bread is golden and the asparagus is al dente. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate. Spread the porcini mayonnaise over the pieces of grilled bread. Top with the grilled asparagus and the mushroom mixture. Garnish with the eggs. Season the eggs with salt and pepper. Serve with the lemon wedges.

title: Roasted Chickpea and Feta Wraps
recipeIngredients: 1 can (19 oz/540 ml) chickpeas, rinsed and drained; 1 red onion, thinly sliced; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1/2 cup (125 ml) sour cream or plain yogurt; 1/2 cup (60 g) feta cheese, crumbled; 1/4 cup (10 g) mint leaves, torn; 1 lemon, zest finely grated; 1 garlic clove, finely grated; 1 tomato, diced; 4 soft wheat tortillas, each 10 inches (25 cm) in diameter; 1/2 iceberg lettuce, leaves torn
recipeInstructions: In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook the chickpeas and onion in the oil until nicely browned, about 12 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add more oil as needed. Remove from the heat and let cool. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the sour cream, feta, mint, lemon zest, garlic and tomato. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Add the chickpea mixture and mix well. Adjust the seasoning.  On a work surface, lay out the tortillas. Divide the lettuce and the chickpea mixture among the tortillas. Fold the sides of the tortilla in towards the centre and tightly roll up from bottom to top to seal in the fillings. Serve with fresh vegetable crudités or a green salad, if desired.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipeIngredients: 1 large red onion, sliced into thin wedges; 2 bell peppers, various colours, seeded and cut into strips; 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 1 1/2 lb (675 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs and breasts, cut into strips (see note)	; 1 tbsp chili powder; 8 medium soft flour tortillas; 1 lime, sliced into wedges; 1/4 cup (10 g) fresh cilantro leaves; 2 cups (200 g) mild orange cheddar, grated; Homemade or store-bought salsa, to taste; Homemade or store-bought guacamole, to taste; Sour cream, to taste

In a bowl, combine the chicken with the chili powder and remaining oil. Spread the chicken out on top of the vegetables. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through, stirring halfway through.  Meanwhile, wrap the tortillas in foil. Place them on the rack in the oven for the last 5 minutes of the cooking time for the chicken.  Remove the baking sheet from the oven and top the chicken and vegetables with lime wedges and cilantro leaves. Place the baking sheet in the middle of the dining table along with the tortillas, cheese, salsa, guacamole and sour cream so that everyone can make their own fajitas.

title: Nordic Shrimp Rolls
recipeIngredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 1 tbsp dill, finely chopped ; 1 lemon, zest finely grated ; 2 tsp (10 ml) lemon juice; 1/4 cup (60 ml) sour cream; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) whole-grain mustard ; 1 tbsp parsley, finely chopped ; 2 tsp (10 ml) lemon juice; 1 green onion, chopped; 1 lb (450 g) Nordic shrimp, fresh or frozen and thawed, peeled and patted very dry; 1 1/4 cups (145 g) celeriac, julienned on a mandoline or grated ; 1/2 green apple, julienned on a mandoline or grated ; Tabasco-style sauce, to taste; 4 brioche hot dog buns; 8 Boston lettuce leaves; 1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced into thin rounds on a mandoline; 1 radish, sliced into thin rounds on a mandoline; 3 tbsp fresh samphire (see note) ; Dill fronds, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Spread the mayonnaise over the inside of the buns. Add the lettuce leaves and remoulade. Top with the cucumber, radish, samphire and dill fronds. Serve immediately. Delicious with fried onion rings or potato chips.

title: Asian-Style Chicken Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 2 garlic cloves, chopped; 1 lime, zest finely grated; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lime juice; 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) fish sauce; 1 tbsp fresh ginger, finely chopped; 1 tbsp brown sugar; 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts; 2 carrots, peeled and grated; 1/4  cup (40 g) roasted peanuts, roughly chopped, plus  more for serving; 2 tbsp (30 ml) rice vinegar; 1 tsp (15 ml) mirin; 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) sambal oelek; 4 submarine buns ou 2 baguettes, each cut into 2 and cut in half horizontally ; Mayonnaise, to taste; 1/4 lb (115 g) green beans, blanched; Cilantro leaves, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a glass dish or a large ziploc bag, combine the garlic, lime zest and juice, oil, fish sauce, ginger and brown sugar. Add the chicken and coat well in the marinade. Cover the dish or seal the bag. Refrigerate for between 1 and 12 hours.  In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Refrigerate while you assemble the sandwiches.  Preheat the grill, setting the burners to medium (see note). Oil the grate.  Drain the chicken well and discard the marinade. Grill the chicken for 7 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Transfer to a plate and let cool for 7 minutes. On a work surface, slice the chicken breasts into long pieces that are about ½-inch (1 cm) thick.  Spread the inside of the buns with mayonnaise. Cover with chicken and carrot salad. Top with green beans, peanuts and cilantro.

title: Beef and Caramelized Onion Toasts
recipeIngredients: ½ cup (125 ml) sour cream; 1 tbsp (15 ml) whole-grain mustard; 1 tbsp dill, finely chopped ; 1 tsp (5 ml) prepared horseradish (optional); 1 lb (450 g) beef top sirloin steak, ¾ inch (2 cm) thick ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 2	small red onions, thinly sliced; ¼ cup (60 ml) water; 4	slices country bread, each ¾ inch (2 cm) thick, toasted ; ¾ cup (20 g) arugula; Sharp cheddar cheese shavings, to taste (see note)
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the sour cream, mustard, dill and horseradish. Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the meat in the oil for 2 minutes on each side for rare or just until the desired doneness. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate to rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in the same skillet over medium-high heat, cook the onions until nicely caramelized, about 5 minutes. Add more oil as needed. Deglaze with the water and let reduce until dry, stirring with a wooden spoon. On a work surface, thinly slice the steak. Spread the sour cream mixture over the toasted bread. Top with the onions, steak and arugula. Season with pepper. Sprinkle with the cheddar cheese shavings. Delicious served with a bowl of soup.

title: Pull-Apart Mini Pizza Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1	can (14 oz/398 ml) diced tomatoes, drained; 2	garlic cloves, finely grated; 2 tbsp (30 ml) tomato paste; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil, plus more for brushing; 1 tbsp dried black olives, pitted and chopped (optional); 1 tsp dried oregano, plus more for sprinkling ; ¼ tsp red pepper flakes; 12	mini brioche hamburger buns, pulled apart and cut in half horizontally ; 3 oz (85 g) pepperoni slices; ½ cup (140 g) store-bought roasted bell peppers, drained and coarsely chopped; 1 ½ cups (150 g) mozzarella cheese, grated ; 24	basil leaves
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a small 13 x 9-inch (33 x 23 cm) baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Place the bun bottoms on the baking sheet. Cover with the tomato sauce. Cover tightly with a large piece of foil. Bake for 30 minutes or until the cheese has completely melted. Remove the foil and serve immediately.

title: Hot Chicken-Style Sandwiches with Duck
recipeIngredients: 6 tbsp (85 g) butter; 1/4 cup (40 g) unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 tsp sweet paprika; 1/2 tsp chili powder; 1/4 tsp celery salt; 2 cups (500 ml) chicken broth; 2 onions, thinly sliced; 1 garlic clove, finely chopped ; 2 cups (300 g) frozen peas, thawed; 2 duck confit thighs, skin removed, deboned and shredded; 8 slices of bread
recipeInstructions: In a pot over medium-high heat, melt ¼ cup (55 g) of the butter. Add the flour and spices. Cook, stirring continuously, for 2 minutes or until the mixture is lightly golden. Pour in the broth. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Season with salt and pepper.  Meanwhile, in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, soften the onions and garlic in the remaining butter. Add the green peas and the duck and stir until heated through. Season with salt and pepper.  Divide the duck mixture on 4 slices of bread. Drizzle with some of the sauce. Top with the remaining slices of bread, and drizzle with the remaining sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Shredded Turkey Sandwich with Gravy
recipeIngredients: ⅓ cup (60 g) cooked turkey, shredded; 1 tbsp (15 ml) Dijon mustard; 1 tbsp (15 ml) onion confit ; 1 tbsp parsley leaves, finely chopped ; 1	slice raclette cheese (about 1 oz/30 g) or sharp cheddar cheese, halved ; ¼ 	baguette, cut in half horizontally, warmed ; ⅓ cup (75 ml) gravy-style brown sauce, warmed
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the turkey, mustard, onion confit and parsley. Season with salt and pepper. Layer the cheese and the turkey mixture onto the bottom half of the baguette. Close the sandwich. Place the sandwich in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted. On a work surface, cut the sandwich in half, if desired. Serve with the sauce for dipping.

title: Tempeh Subs
recipeIngredients: ½ cup (125 ml) water; 3 tbsp (45 ml) ketchup; 3 tbsp (45 ml) low-sodium soy sauce; 2 tbsp brown sugar ; ½ tsp garlic powder ; ¼ tsp cayenne pepper; 2	packages (240 g each) tempeh, broken into pieces; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1	small red onion, thinly sliced; 1 tbsp (15 ml) red wine vinegar; 2 cups (50 g) arugula; ¼ cup (10 g) dill, coarsely chopped ; 4	submarine buns, each 9 inches (23 cm) long; Prepared yellow mustard, to taste; 8	slices Monterey Jack or mild cheddar cheese (5 oz/140 g), halved ; Spicy banana pepper rings, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the water, ketchup, soy sauce, brown sugar and spices. In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook the tempeh in the oil until nicely browned, about 7 minutes. Pour in the sauce and mix to coat the tempeh. Bring to a boil. Let reduce until dry. Remove from the heat. In a bowl, combine the onion and vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Add the arugula and dill. Mix well. On a work surface, cut the submarine buns in half horizontally without going all the way through to the other side. Open like a book and cover the insides with mustard. Divide the cheese among the bun bottoms. Top with the arugula salad, tempeh and banana peppers. Close the sandwiches. Cut in half, if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Pork Salad Pita Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless pork chops, ¾ inch (2 cm) thick (about 3 pork chops); 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 12	kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped; 2	green onions, thinly sliced; 1	red bell pepper, seeded and diced; 3 tbsp (45 ml) sour cream; ½ tsp dried oregano ; ¼ tsp garlic powder ; 2 	pita breads (see note), halved ; Basil pesto, to taste; Boston lettuce leaves ; 1 	tomato, sliced; 2 	Lebanese cucumbers, sliced into long ribbons
recipeInstructions: In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, brown the pork chops in the oil for 3 minutes on each side. Season with salt and pepper. Let cool on a plate for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. On a work surface, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. Using a knife, cut away the excess fat from the pork. Dice the pork chops and add to the bowl of salad. Mix well. Adjust the seasoning. On a work surface, carefully open the pitas into pockets. Cover the inside of the pitas with the pesto and fill with lettuce leaves. Divide the tomato slices, pork salad and cucumber ribbons among the pitas. Serve with oven fries or chips, if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Garlic and Cream Cheese Bread Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipeIngredients: ½ block (125 g) cream cheese, softened; ¼ cup (55 g) butter, softened; 1	garlic clove, finely chopped; 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped; 1 tsp jalapeño chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped; 1	large plain hamburger bun or kaiser roll, halved horizontally
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the cream cheese, butter, garlic, parsley and jalapeño. The garlic and cheese spread will keep for 1 week in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Let sit out at room temperature before using. Preheat a mini electric sandwich maker for 5 minutes. Cover the bottom of the bun with 3 tbsp (45 ml) of the garlic and cheese spread. Close with the top of the bun. Place the sandwich in the sandwich maker. Close the machine and cook for 4 minutes or until the bread is nicely browned. Cut into strips. Serve with spaghetti or soup, if desired.

title: Fried Egg and Sausage Breakfast Sandwich
recipeIngredients: ¼ cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 1 tbsp (15 ml) Dijon mustard; 1 tbsp (15 ml) whole-grain mustard; 4	Toulouse sausages, meat only; 6 cups (140 g) baby spinach; 4	slices raclette cheese; 4	brioche hamburger buns; 1 tbsp butter; 4	eggs; 4	leaves curly lettuce; 2 tbsp sour gherkins, chopped ; 2 tbsp dill, finely chopped ; ½ 	shallot, chopped
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Set aside. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Shape the sausage meat into 4 patties slightly wider than the hamburger buns. Lightly oil the patties. In a large non-stick skillet over high heat, cook the sausage patties on each side until browned, about 6 minutes. Set aside on the baking sheet. In the same skillet, cook the spinach in the sausage fat until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Place the spinach over the sausage patties. Top with a slice of cheese. Clean out the skillet. Place the buns beside the patties on the baking sheet, cut sides up. Bake everything for 2 to 3 minutes or until the buns are warm and the cheese is melted. Meanwhile, in the clean skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Crack the eggs into the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny. Season with salt and pepper. Spread the mayonnaise sauce over the inside of the buns. Top the bun bottoms with the lettuce, sausage patties and eggs. Sprinkle with the pickles, dill and shallot. Close with the bun tops.

title: Scrambled Egg and Barbecue Mushroom Breakfast Sandwich
recipeIngredients: ⅓ cup (75 ml) ketchup; 1 tbsp (15 ml) molasses; 1 tsp chipotle chili powder (see note); ½ lb (225 g) white mushrooms, cut into slices ¼ inch (5 mm) ; 2 tbsp butter ; 4	rustic hamburger buns; 3 tbsp butter; 12	eggs, lightly beaten; 8	slices orange cheddar cheese; ¼ cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 1	large tomato, sliced; 4	Boston lettuce leaves; 1	green onion, chopped; ¼ cup (10 g) cilantro, finely chopped; 1	lime, quartered
recipeInstructions: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the ketchup, molasses and chili powder. Cook in the microwave oven for 30 seconds or until the sauce is hot and glossy (see note). In a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, brown the mushrooms in the butter. Add 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the barbecue sauce and cook for 1 minute, stirring, until the mushrooms are caramelized. Set aside on a plate. Clean out the skillet. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).  In the clean skillet over medium-high heat, toast the inside of the hamburger buns. Set aside. Wipe out the skillet. In the clean skillet over medium-high heat, melt the butter. Add the eggs. Season with salt and pepper. Stir slowly with a spatula or wooden spoon, scraping the bottom and sides of the skillet, just until the eggs have coagulated but are still slightly wet, about 3 minutes.  In the skillet, divide the eggs into 4 patties the same diameter as the hamburger buns. Place 1 slice of cheese over each portion of egg. Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 2 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the eggs have firmed up. Spread the mayonnaise and remaining barbecue sauce over the inside of the hamburger buns. Top the bun bottoms with the remaining cheese. Top with the mushrooms and eggs. Garnish with the lettuce and tomato. Sprinkle with the green onion and cilantro. Drizzle with lime juice. Close with the bun tops.
description: Scrambled Egg and Barbecue Mushroom Breakfast Sandwich

title: Ground Beef-Stuffed Dinner Rolls
recipeIngredients: 2 lb (900 g) medium-lean ground beef ; 1	onion, chopped; 2	celery stalks, chopped; ¼ cup (60 ml) ketchup; ¼ cup (60 ml) prepared yellow mustard ; 1	can (10 oz/284 ml) condensed chicken gumbo soup (Campbell’s-style); 2 tbsp (30 ml) Worcestershire sauce; 24	dinner rolls
recipeInstructions: In a large pot, combine all of the ingredients except for the dinner rolls. Bring to a boil. Simmer over medium-low heat for 30 minutes or until the liquid has completely evaporated, stirring a few times. Season with salt and pepper. With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).  Make an incision in the top of each bun without going all the way through to the bottom. Fill with the meat mixture. Place the filled buns on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until the bread is hot and crispy. Cover with foil if needed.

title: Ground Beef Pita Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1 cup (250 ml) plain yogurt; ¼ tsp salt ; 1/8 tsp ground coriander ; 1/8 tsp ground black pepper ; 1/8 tsp ground cumin ; 1/8 tsp ground sumac (see note); 3 pita breads, each 8 inches (20 cm) in diameter  ; ¾ lb (340 g) lean ground beef; 1 small onion, finely chopped; ⅓ cup (15 g) parsley, finely chopped; 2 tsp breadcrumbs  ; 2 tsp ground coriander; 1 tsp ground cumin ; ½ tsp lemon zest, finely grated; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to serve. With the rack in the lowest position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).  On a work surface, cut the pitas in half and open into pockets. In a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients except for the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Spread about ¼ cup (60 ml) of the beef mixture inside each pita half. Press down lightly to stick the pita to the meat filling. Using a pastry brush, cover the outside of the pitas with the oil. Place the stuffed pitas on a non-stick baking sheet, evenly spaced out (see note). Bake for 10 minutes, turning the sandwiches over halfway through, or until the pitas are golden and the meat is cooked through. On a work surface, cut the sandwiches into triangles and serve with the spicy yogurt. Serve with a green salad, if desired.

title: Curry Omelette Sandwiches
recipeIngredients: 1	red bell pepper, seeded and cut into rounds ½ inch (1 cm) thick ; 1	onion, cut into rounds ½ inch (1 cm) ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 4	slices bacon, halved; 10	eggs ; 2 tsp curry powder ; 2 tbsp butter ; 4	slices mozzarella cheese; 4	brioche hamburger buns; ¼ cup (60 ml) mayonnaise ; 8	slices smoked ham ; 2 cups (50 g) arugula
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).  On a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet, toss the vegetables with the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange the vegetables on one side of the baking sheet. Arrange the bacon on the other side of the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and the bacon is crispy. Pat the vegetables and bacon dry with paper towels, as needed. Set aside. Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk the eggs with 1 tsp of the curry powder. Season with salt and pepper. In a 10 ½-inch (27 cm) crepe pan over medium heat, melt one-quarter of the butter. Pour in one-quarter (½ cup/125 ml) of the egg mixture. Cook until the surface of the omelette is still slightly runny. Place 1 slice of cheese at the centre of the omelette. Fold two opposite sides of the omelette over the cheese, then fold over the other two sides to form a square. Set aside on a plate. Repeat with the remaining butter, egg mixture and cheese. In the same pan, toast the inside of the hamburger buns. In a bowl, combine the mayonnaise and remaining curry powder. Spread the curry mayonnaise over the insides of the hamburger buns. Top the bun bottoms with the ham, omelettes, vegetables, bacon and arugula. Close with the bun tops.

title: Sardine Toasts
recipeIngredients: 1/2 baguette; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil, plus more for serving; 1	garlic clove, halved; 1	tomato, cut in half ; ½ cup (120 g) marinated roasted bell peppers, cut into strips (see note) ; 1	can (about 100 g) oil-packed sardines, drained ; 1	small shallot, cut into thin rounds; 1	lemon, juice only
recipeInstructions: Cut the baguette in half horizontally, then cut crosswise for a total of 4 pieces. Drizzle with the olive oil. Toast on a grill or thread onto a branch and cook over a campfire until golden. Rub the toast with the garlic and then rub the toast thoroughly with a tomato half, pressing firmly with the tomato. Dice the remaining tomato half. Season with salt and pepper. Top the toast with the roasted bell peppers, diced tomato, sardines and shallot. Drizzle with the lemon juice and more olive oil, if desired.

title: Burrata, Roasted Tomato and Fried Egg Toasts
recipeIngredients: 2 cups (280 g) cherry tomatoes, various colours, halved ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 1 tbsp (15 ml) white wine vinegar; ¼ tsp salt ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 4	eggs; 4	slices country bread, grilled ; 1	garlic clove, halved; 1	burrata (250 g), at room temperature, drained and torn into pieces ; 2 tbsp chives, cut into ½-inch (1.5 cm) pieces ; Fleur de sel; Red pepper flakes (optional)
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with pepper. Let marinate for 5 minutes. Drain well. Place the tomatoes, cut side up, on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until the tomatoes start to soften and are lightly browned. Meanwhile, in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high, heat the oil until lightly simmering (see note). Carefully crack the eggs directly into the skillet and cook, on one side only, for 2 to 3 minutes or until the whites are set and the edges are golden and crispy. Rub the grilled bread with the garlic clove. Top the bread with the burrata and tomatoes. Sprinkle with the chives. Place a fried egg on each toast. Sprinkle with fleur de sel and red pepper flakes, if desired.

title: Pulled Turkey Rolls with Creamy Montreal Steak Spice Barbecue Sauce
recipeIngredients: 2 tbsp brown sugar ; 2 tbsp smoked paprika ; 1 tbsp salt; 1 tbsp ground black pepper; 1	turkey breast half, with bone and skin, about 1 ¾ lb (800 g) (see note) ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) apple cider vinegar; 1 cup (250 ml) beer ; 6 tbsp (90 ml) ketchup; 6 tbsp (90 ml) mayonnaise; 2 tbsp brown sugar; 2 tbsp (30 ml) prepared yellow mustard; 1 tbsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar; 2 tsp Montreal steak spice ; 1 tsp smoked paprika ; 1	garlic clove, finely chopped; 8	hot dog buns, lightly buttered; 3	Lebanese cucumbers, sliced into long ribbons; 1	small red onion, thinly sliced
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the brown sugar, paprika, salt and pepper. Place the turkey breast in a glass dish, skin-side up. With your fingers, carefully loosen the skin from the flesh without removing it. Drizzle with the vinegar. Rub some of the spice mixture between the skin and flesh. Rub the remaining spice mixture over the entire turkey breast. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Preheat half of the grill, setting the burners to high. Drain the turkey breast and place in a foil dish. Add the beer and cover with foil. Place the dish on the side of the barbecue that is off. Close the lid and cook for 2 hours, maintaining the barbecue temperature at 500°F (260°C), until the meat is fork-tender and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Remove from the heat. Let rest for 15 minutes. Remove the turkey from the dish. Shred the meat, removing all the skin and bones. Place the meat in a large bowl. Add 6 tbsp (90 ml) of the cooking juices. Mix well. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Toast the hot dog buns. Spread with the barbecue sauce and fill with the shredded turkey, cucumbers and onion.
description: Pulled Turkey Rolls with Creamy Montreal Steak Spice Barbecue Sauce

title: Lobster Croque Monsieur
recipeIngredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter; 2 tbsp unbleached all-purpose flour; 1 cup (250 ml) milk; 1 pinch nutmeg; 4 thick slices white bread, lightly toasted ; 1 lobster (1 lb/450 g), cooked and shelled (see note) ; 4 oz (115 g) Pied-de-Vent, Riopelle or Sauvagine cheese, sliced; Fresh chives, finely chopped, to taste
recipeInstructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Whisk in the milk and bring to a boil, whisking constantly. Simmer gently for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.  With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place the bread slices on the baking sheet. Spread a little béchamel on each slice and cover with lobster and cheese. Drizzle with béchamel and season with salt.  Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until the béchamel is lightly browned and the cheese is melted. Sprinkle with chives, if desired.

title: Merguez and Marinated Fennel on Toast
recipeIngredients: 1	fennel bulb, thinly sliced on a mandoline; 1 tbsp fennel fronds, finely chopped ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice; ¼ tsp salt ; 8	merguez sausages; 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil; ½ cup (125 ml) mayonnaise; 1	lemon, zest finely grated; 1 tbsp mint leaves, finely chopped, plus more for serving ; 1	baguette, halved horizontally, each half cut in 2 pieces, warmed ; 2 cups (90 g) curly-leaf lettuce, torn
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, combine the sliced fennel with the fennel fronds, half of the lemon juice and the salt. Let marinate while you prepare the next steps. Meanwhile, in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, cook the sausages in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes or until cooked through. Pat dry with paper towels. On a work surface, cut each sausage in half lengthwise. Set aside on a plate. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, lemon zest, mint and remaining lemon juice. Lightly season with salt and pepper. Spread the lemon mayonnaise over the sliced baguette. Top with the lettuce. Place 4 sausage halves on each piece of bread and garnish with the marinated fennel. Sprinkle with mint leaves, if desired.

title: Beef Sandwiches with Mushrooms and Pickled Cabbage
recipeIngredients: 4 cups (340 g) green cabbage, thinly sliced on a mandoline; 1 tsp salt; 1	 carrot, grated ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) apple cider vinegar; 1 tbsp fresh dill, finely chopped ; 1 lb (450 g) beef top sirloin steak, about ¾ inch (2 cm) thick ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; ½ lb (225 g) white mushrooms, sliced; 1 tbsp (15 ml) whole-grain mustard, plus more for serving; 1 tsp steak spice ; ½ cup (125 ml) chicken broth; 4	submarine buns, each 10 inches (25 cm) long, warmed ; 3 oz (85 g) sharp cheddar cheese, grated
recipeInstructions: In a large bowl, massage the cabbage and salt with your hands to extract some water from the cabbage, about 2 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Let marinate while you prepare the sandwiches. In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, brown the beef in 1 tbsp (15 ml) of the oil for 2 minutes on each side for rare or until the desired doneness. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside on a plate and let rest.  In the same skillet, brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil for 5 minutes. Add the mustard and steak spice. Mix well to coat the mushrooms. Deglaze with the broth and let reduce until the mushrooms are glazed with the sauce. On a work surface, slice the meat as thinly as possible (see note). Cut the buns in half horizontally without going all the way through to the other side. Open them like a book and cover the insides with mustard. Cover one side of each bun with the mushrooms, sliced steak and cheese. Top with the pickled cabbage. Serve immediately with any remaining pickled cabbage.

title: Parmesan Crusted Sweet Potato, Red Cabbage and Sesame Pita Sandwiches

Add the Parmesan and sesame seeds and mix to coat well. Spread out on a baking sheet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for 15 minutes. Turn the sweet potatoes over and continue cooking for about 15 minutes or until the sweet potatoes are tender and golden brown.   In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Let marinate for about 10 minutes.  In a bowl, whisk all the ingredients together. Set aside. Spread each pita with tahini mayonnaise. Top with red cabbage, sweet potatoes, green beans and basil. Roll up the pita to close up the sandwich.

title: Mashed Potato and Gruyère Grilled Cheese

title: Curry Tofu, Avocado and Apple Coleslaw Wraps
recipeIngredients: 2 tbsp cornstarch; 1 tbsp (15 ml) tamari sauce; 1 tbsp (15 ml) honey; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lime juice; 1 tsp curry powder ; 1 tsp onion powder; 1	block (450 g) firm tofu, coarsely torn into 15 pieces; 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil; 3 cups (255 g) Savoy cabbage or green cabbage, thinly sliced ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) lime juice, plus more for drizzling; ¼ cup (60 ml) mayonnaise; 1 tsp (5 ml) Sriracha; 1	Cortland apple, halved, cored and thinly sliced; 4	soft wheat tortillas, around 12 inches (30 cm) in diametre ; 2	small ripe avocados, halved
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the cornstarch, tamari, honey, lime juice, curry powder and onion powder. Season with salt and pepper. Add the tofu and mix to coat in the sauce. In a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, heat the oil. Spread the tofu and sauce out in the skillet. Brown the tofu on all sides, about 5 minutes. Spread out on a plate and let cool (see note). Meanwhile, in another bowl, combine the cabbage and lime juice. Season with salt. Let sit for 15 minutes. Drain and discard any excess liquid. Add the mayonnaise and Sriracha to the cabbage. Add the apple. Season with pepper and mix well. On a work surface, lay out the tortillas. Using a fork, mash an avocado half at the centre of each tortilla. Drizzle lightly with lime juice. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the coleslaw and tofu among the tortillas. Fold the two opposite sides of each tortilla in towards the centre, then roll up from the bottom towards the top around the filling. Cover with parchment paper or plastic wrap.
description: Curry Tofu, Avocado and Apple Coleslaw Wraps

title: Sweet Potato and Roast Pork on Toast
recipeIngredients: 2	large sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into slices about ½ inch (1.5 cm) thick ; 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil; 1	pork tenderloin, about 1 lb (450 g), trimmed ; 1 tbsp (15 ml) whole-grain mustard, plus more for serving ; 1	ciabatta baguette, cut in half horizontally; 1	Granny Smith apple, cored and cut into thin sticks ; 1	shallot, thinly sliced; 2 cups (50 g) arugula; 3 tbsp roasted pumpkin seeds ; 3 tbsp dried cranberries ; 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice
recipeInstructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C).  On a non-stick or parchment paper-lined baking sheet, toss the sweet potatoes with 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the oil. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, on a plate, coat the pork with the mustard and remaining oil. Season with salt and pepper. Flip the potatoes over and move them away from the centre of the baking sheet. Place the pork at the centre of the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the centre of the pork reads 135°F (57°C). Remove from the oven. Cover with foil and let sit for 5 minutes. On a work surface, thinly slice the pork. Toast the bread directly on the oven rack for 3 to 4 minutes. Brush with mustard, if desired. In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Using a fork, coarsely crush the potatoes onto the toasted bread. Top with the pork and salad. Serve warm
